E7UflNmgJ1.claimed_gains: WaveGSSM reduces geopotential RMSE by 20.2% on average for 1- to 5-day weather forecasts relative to a backbone-matched snapshot model.

56TM4VUxgU.one_liner: Disentangled task dynamics and conditioned rectified flow turn temporal compatibility changes into dense robot rewards.
56TM4VUxgU.problem: Video-derived rewards in entangled visual spaces can respond to distractors instead of task execution, while manual rewards require substantial engineering.
56TM4VUxgU.method: DiTaR uses asymmetric two-stage representation learning to separate task-relevant state from irrelevant visual variation. A history- and language-conditioned rectified-flow model learns latent task dynamics, and temporal changes in dynamics compatibility define directional dense rewards.
56TM4VUxgU.key_idea: Disentangle task state, model its conditioned latent dynamics with rectified flow, and derive rewards from temporal changes in dynamics compatibility.
56TM4VUxgU.evidence: Experiments compare video-based reward baselines on MetaWorld-v3 and ManiSkill, while the TL;DR also reports real-world offline policy learning.

QStU5ZgffS.one_liner: Outcome-conditioned sparse-feature histories gate signed latent corrections to pretrained robot action policies.
QStU5ZgffS.problem: Few-rollout improvement of robot action models requires identifying which feature to steer, when to intervene, and the correction's sign.
QStU5ZgffS.method: STEERACT builds successful and failed reference banks from sparse-feature temporal descriptors and selects the most outcome-separating feature. Support and failure gates trigger a bounded signed-correction search toward successful references, adapting only the intervention coefficient online.
QStU5ZgffS.key_idea: Compare sparse-feature temporal descriptors with outcome-conditioned reference banks, then gate and search signed corrections along one fixed feature direction.
QStU5ZgffS.evidence: Closed-loop robot-policy evaluations use 24 outcome-labeled reference rollouts per task and compare against unsteered policies.
QStU5ZgffS.claimed_gains: Using 24 outcome-labeled reference rollouts per task, STEERACT improves task success by approximately 10% relative to unsteered policies.

vp7YLGcPO4.one_liner: Early decoding queries calibrated by global prefill queries score cached tokens for mixed-precision KV quantization.
vp7YLGcPO4.problem: Mixed-precision KV compression must predict future token importance from limited evidence before aggressively compressing cached entries.
vp7YLGcPO4.method: ForeKV delays compression to collect early decoding queries, calibrates their importance estimate using the global prefill mean query, and directly scores cached keys. A paged-attention kernel supports token-wise K4/K2 allocation with channel-wise quantization.
vp7YLGcPO4.key_idea: Calibrate early-decoding query evidence with the mean prefill query, then score cached keys to allocate token-wise quantization precision.
vp7YLGcPO4.evidence: Experiments evaluate multiple LLM backbones on LongBench against BF16.
vp7YLGcPO4.claimed_gains: ForeKV remains close to BF16 at an effective compressed-cache storage ratio of approximately 5.0×.

3UkdMRuupk.one_liner: Paired performance certification selects smaller planning budgets, and cached static context avoids repeated world-model encoding.
3UkdMRuupk.problem: World-model planning uses conservatively large budgets and repeatedly encodes observation and goal context that does not change within a solve.
3UkdMRuupk.method: SufficientPlan uses paired closed-loop evidence to certify model-task-specific reduced budgets within a predefined full-performance tolerance. It caches observation and goal representations across search iterations while preserving candidate-dependent planning and selected actions.
3UkdMRuupk.key_idea: Certify reduced search budgets using paired closed-loop performance and reuse invariant observation and goal encodings across planning iterations.
3UkdMRuupk.evidence: Experiments across multiple world-model backbones and visual-control tasks assess search budgets, planning latency, and control performance.

o8gryDygzk.one_liner: A shared token-query operator backbone adapts to PDEs through lightweight adapters trained with equation-derived losses.
o8gryDygzk.problem: Adapting operator foundation models typically requires expensive high-fidelity solution data from simulations or observations.
o8gryDygzk.method: SymOnet pretrains a token-query architecture across PDE families to map input functions and space-time coordinates to solutions. Downstream adaptation freezes the backbone and optimizes lightweight adapters using automatically differentiated losses from governing equations and initial and boundary conditions.
o8gryDygzk.key_idea: Freeze a shared multi-PDE token-query backbone and train adapters using governing-equation, initial-condition, and boundary-condition losses computed by automatic differentiation.
o8gryDygzk.evidence: A family-wise operator-approximation theorem accompanies comparable-size baseline evaluations on 12 tasks under expression-driven and data-driven fine-tuning.
o8gryDygzk.claimed_gains: SymOnet outperforms all evaluated baselines on all 12 tasks under expression-driven fine-tuning and attains the lowest L2RE on 9 tasks under data-driven fine-tuning.

V0sUs6rxDv.one_liner: Joint flow-matching experts predict video, tactile states, and actions using a shared representation of heterogeneous tactile sensors.
V0sUs6rxDv.problem: Treating tactile sensing only as action conditioning neglects future contact dynamics and heterogeneous sensor representations.
V0sUs6rxDv.method: ME-Dex maps sensor surfaces to a Canonical Hand Model and encodes them with a Unified Tactile Autoencoder. Video, Tactile, and Action Experts use flow matching and intermediate joint attention to generate future observations and actions together.
V0sUs6rxDv.key_idea: Canonical hand alignment unifies tactile inputs, while joint attention couples flow-matching experts for future visual states, tactile states, and actions.
V0sUs6rxDv.evidence: Experiments evaluate manipulation on RoboTwin, DexJoCo, and ManiFeel using joint visual, tactile, and action learning.
V0sUs6rxDv.claimed_gains: Average manipulation success exceeds the strongest baselines by 11.2, 8.9, and 15.0 percentage points on RoboTwin, DexJoCo, and ManiFeel, respectively.

yvQE8LfcMX.one_liner: Anisotropic covariance weights latent diffusion guidance by direction-specific uncertainty when solving inverse problems.
yvQE8LfcMX.problem: Uniform latent-space guidance ignores which directions measurements inform and how prediction reliability changes across inputs and timesteps.
yvQE8LfcMX.method: ANaLOG learns an anisotropic covariance that depends on the input and timestep. It integrates this covariance into native-latent guidance to weight reliable directions more strongly than uncertain ones.
yvQE8LfcMX.key_idea: Input- and time-dependent anisotropic covariance weights latent guidance according to directional prediction uncertainty.
yvQE8LfcMX.evidence: Linear-model analysis establishes the need for anisotropic weighting for correct sampling, and experiments cover five inverse problems.

j0e9mjhl03.one_liner: Coupled working and experiential memories guide agent skills and supply failure evidence for validation-gated recursive memory updates.
j0e9mjhl03.problem: Growing histories obscure task progress and skill selection while making long-horizon agent failures difficult to localize.
j0e9mjhl03.method: Recuris uses Working Memory to track task progress and select skills from Experiential Memory, recording structured execution evidence. A fixed Meta-Agent uses that evidence for localized, validation-gated memory updates across tasks.
j0e9mjhl03.key_idea: Working Memory guides experiential skill selection, and localized failure evidence drives a bounded loop of validated memory updates.
j0e9mjhl03.evidence: Evaluation covers four long-horizon benchmarks and ten models, including tau-squared-Bench Retail and SkillFlow with frontier and open-source models.
j0e9mjhl03.claimed_gains: Recuris reports +17.8 and +15.6 points for GPT-5.6 Sol and Claude Opus 5 on tau-squared-Bench Retail, reaching 87.9% for Opus 5, +16.6/+13.5 points for Qwen3.6-27B/35B on SkillFlow, and +32.2 points on the longest tasks.

jY5hxyrysy.one_liner: Region-wise gates retain target-useful prefix corrections in source-conditioned autoregressive 3D medical image translation.
jY5hxyrysy.problem: Prefix corrections vary in usefulness across regions, and their prediction-change magnitude does not indicate whether they help the target.
jY5hxyrysy.method: SPIRA finds the largest removable portion of each prefix correction that does not increase target loss at current training prediction states. A lightweight gate learns to reproduce the resulting predictive distribution and control source-prefix balance during generation.
jY5hxyrysy.key_idea: A learned regional gate retains prefix corrections according to training targets derived by removing corrections without increasing target loss.
jY5hxyrysy.evidence: Experiments span multiple modalities and 3D medical translation tasks, with mechanism analyses comparing correction effects, target utility, and oracle decisions.

9jsB4PHwnb.one_liner: Privileged in-context step-ins steer self-distillation rollouts toward edited knowledge while preserving on-policy generation elsewhere.
9jsB4PHwnb.problem: Unstructured knowledge editors can make models recall a passage without enabling factual questions or multi-hop composition of its contents.
9jsB4PHwnb.method: HPSE frames editing as self-distillation from a privileged in-context version of the same model without external supervision. Hybrid rollouts insert privileged guidance when the student drifts off-topic and otherwise remain on-policy.
9jsB4PHwnb.key_idea: Hybrid rollouts combine on-policy generation with privileged in-context interventions that redirect the student toward the knowledge being edited.

Tr2DMJ4KQS.one_liner: Question-conditioned causal attention selects compact scene subgraphs to ground visual question answering.
Tr2DMJ4KQS.problem: Complete scene graphs can distract vision-language models with irrelevant information and contribute to unsupported answers.
Tr2DMJ4KQS.method: The framework predicts question-relevant subgraphs using dual-differential causal attention over node-node dependencies and node-query associations. A generated factual-counterfactual dataset supplies fine-grained grounding supervision.
Tr2DMJ4KQS.key_idea: Joint node-node and node-query causal attention assesses graph elements to select a question-relevant subgraph.
Tr2DMJ4KQS.evidence: Experiments compare the method with other approaches on multiple benchmarks whose names are not stated.

ZPUlW2azQq.one_liner: Frozen forecasting-model hidden states retrieve historical continuations that correct the model's forecast without additional training.
ZPUlW2azQq.problem: Raw-series or separate-embedding retrieval measures context shape rather than the predictive usefulness of historical continuations.
ZPUlW2azQq.method: HiRAF reuses the hidden state from a frozen time series foundation model's forecasting pass as a retrieval key. It retrieves similar segments from the target series history and uses their continuations to correct the backbone forecast.
ZPUlW2azQq.key_idea: Forecasting hidden states serve as predictive retrieval keys for historical continuations used to correct the current forecast.
ZPUlW2azQq.evidence: The abstract compares continuation errors for hidden-state retrieval against raw-series retrieval and retrieval with a separate embedding model.
ZPUlW2azQq.claimed_gains: Retrieved continuations have 14% lower error than with raw-series keys and 17% lower error than with a separate embedding model.

DkWZf1Ktou.one_liner: Composable, continuous visual-transition latents pretrained on unlabeled trajectories support image-goal navigation through a lightweight waypoint head.
DkWZf1Ktou.problem: Action-supervised navigation representations can fail to capture the transition structure underlying viewpoint changes.
DkWZf1Ktou.method: NavCompose pretrains relative visual-transition representations with composability and local continuity regularization on unlabeled trajectories. A frozen, renderable backbone supports viewpoint interpolation and short-horizon extrapolation, while a lightweight head learns downstream waypoints.
DkWZf1Ktou.key_idea: Regularizing consecutive visual transitions for composability and continuity creates a frozen latent representation for downstream waypoint prediction.
DkWZf1Ktou.evidence: Experiments on multiple navigation datasets evaluate waypoint prediction, labeled-trajectory efficiency, and inference runtime.

Z3yZ3PEtbX.one_liner: Prior-weighted proposals, diverse batches, and confidence-based elimination trade parallel evaluations for fewer adaptive search rounds.
Z3yZ3PEtbX.problem: Feedback delays between evaluation batches can dominate AutoML search time even when the total evaluation count stays fixed.
Z3yZ3PEtbX.method: The paper characterizes a sufficient iso-regret tradeoff between parallel batch width and adaptive rounds under regularity, coverage, and calibration conditions. PWBO combines prior-weighted proposals with diversity-aware batch selection and confidence-based elimination.
Z3yZ3PEtbX.key_idea: Prior-weighted proposals and diversity-aware batch selection increase useful within-round coverage, while confidence-based elimination narrows the search.
Z3yZ3PEtbX.evidence: A theoretical reciprocal-log frontier and controlled synthetic experiments varying prior quality and within-round coverage support the depth-width tradeoff.

SRloVBeqrH.one_liner: A separate spatial regulator checks agent beliefs and proposed actions, providing corrective feedback before execution.
SRloVBeqrH.problem: Incorrect beliefs about the environment and task progress persist during long-horizon spatial interactions and cause subsequent decision errors.
SRloVBeqrH.method: Spatial-JARVIS monitors inferred cognitive states and proposed decisions independently of the policy model, then supplies corrective feedback. Training uses MetaSpatial-35K with supervised fine-tuning followed by MC-GRPO, and MetaSpatial-Bench evaluates monitoring and correction.
SRloVBeqrH.key_idea: A decoupled regulator evaluates evolving spatial beliefs and pending decisions, then feeds corrections back to the policy before execution.
SRloVBeqrH.evidence: The paper constructs MetaSpatial-35K and MetaSpatial-Bench and compares spatial monitoring and control against MLLMs.
SRloVBeqrH.claimed_gains: Spatial-JARVIS exceeds the strongest compared MLLMs by 14.6% and 13.3% in monitoring and control, respectively.

NhWZYH5BnQ.one_liner: Text-based reconstruction pretraining teaches local and global geometry before spatial chain-of-thought reasoning with visual compensation.
NhWZYH5BnQ.problem: Answer-only training does not directly supervise intermediate geometric estimates or their use in quantitative spatial reasoning.
NhWZYH5BnQ.method: SpatialSpeak first learns marked-point 3D queries and object-center queries through a shared text-based question-answering interface. Spatial chain-of-thought training then expresses relevant geometric estimates and derives answers, using reliability assessment and visual compensation for refinement.
NhWZYH5BnQ.key_idea: Reconstruction queries teach local geometry and global scene context through the same autoregressive text interface later used for geometric reasoning.
NhWZYH5BnQ.evidence: ReVSI experiments measure reconstruction pretraining's contribution to spatial chain-of-thought gains, with ablations of local and global supervision.
NhWZYH5BnQ.claimed_gains: On ReVSI, QA-RP increases the gain from CoT-VC from 2.6 to 6.9 points.

1ivz5AasHb.one_liner: Partial weight restoration measures how durably diffusion models suppress erased concepts.
1ivz5AasHb.problem: Initial concept suppression does not reveal whether later weight changes can recover erased content.
1ivz5AasHb.method: DuraBench restores edited weights at varying budgets and measures target-generation recovery curves, summarized by the half-recovery budget. SPARC adds post-training to maintain suppression under partial restoration.
1ivz5AasHb.key_idea: Measure the restoration budget needed to move target generation halfway between erased-model and fully restored levels.
1ivz5AasHb.evidence: Experiments on quantized diffusion models show that selective weight restoration can recover concepts despite similar initial suppression across checkpoints.
1ivz5AasHb.claimed_gains: Restoring just 5% of edited weights can markedly increase generation of the erased concept.

p0gEUwFOFV.one_liner: Content-based latent slots accumulate sparse transition evidence before selecting task summaries for offline meta-reinforcement learning.
p0gEUwFOFV.problem: Offline task inference can miss weak but collectively informative transitions when task evidence occurs in brief, unknown intervals.
p0gEUwFOFV.method: STeR softly assigns transition features to content-based latent slots, normalizes each slot independently, and selects relevant summaries with a task-level readout. It learns from trajectory-level task labels without evidence masks or boundary supervision.
p0gEUwFOFV.key_idea: Accumulate transition features in independently normalized slots before selecting task-relevant summaries.
p0gEUwFOFV.evidence: The study examines sparse-evidence offline meta-reinforcement learning and reports that task inference requires preserving weak, collectively informative responses.

bz5nfXyiJr.one_liner: Independent protein folds and invariant residue graphs predict TCR-pMHC binding without constructing a docked complex.
bz5nfXyiJr.problem: Docked-complex binding predictors propagate structure-prediction placement errors into downstream features.
bz5nfXyiJr.method: EMBER folds TCR and pMHC independently, encodes each as an SE(3)-invariant residue graph, and compares their learned representations without a shared coordinate frame.
bz5nfXyiJr.key_idea: Compare invariant representations of independently folded binding partners without using relative pose.
bz5nfXyiJr.evidence: Epitope-disjoint evaluation compares EMBER with six retrained baselines under four folding tools.
bz5nfXyiJr.claimed_gains: EMBER reports gains of 0.9 to 14.4% in micro-AUROC, 18.5 to 25.3% in micro-AUPRC, and 10.6 to 24.1% in MCC*, with ranking up to 85% more stable across folding tools.

zkIGFIFYO4.one_liner: Conjugate geometric interactions produce scalar features, enabling channel mixing to move from edges to nodes in interatomic potentials.
zkIGFIFYO4.problem: Interatomic potentials restrict geometric-to-scalar information flow and spend substantial computation on edges.
zkIGFIFYO4.method: SGBNet adds explicit higher-order-geometric-to-scalar pathways, including conjugate multiplication that cancels shared SO(2) rotation phases. Its convolution uses scalar-feature structure to move channel mixing from edges to nodes.
zkIGFIFYO4.key_idea: Cancel shared rotation phases through conjugate multiplication to form invariant scalars, then relocate channel mixing from edges to nodes.
zkIGFIFYO4.evidence: Experiments cover molecular and materials benchmarks, SPICE-MACE-OFF accuracy–efficiency trade-offs, MLIPAudit comparisons with eSEN-3.2M, and large-scale systems.
zkIGFIFYO4.claimed_gains: SGBNet-N maintains comparable MLIPAudit performance to eSEN-3.2M while reducing runtime and memory consumption by 47% and 60%, respectively.

si8nyKHwD1.one_liner: Budgeted intervention ranking uses held-out transcriptomic outcomes and transfers historical perturbation effects to response-unseen candidates.
si8nyKHwD1.problem: Response-prediction accuracy and known-perturbation recovery do not evaluate which experiments a laboratory should select under a finite budget.
si8nyKHwD1.method: VCDesign ranks candidate interventions and scores selected candidates using transcriptomic responses from held-out replicates. It transfers other genes' measured effects through a learned map, VCDesign-CED, or averaging over STRING network neighbors.
si8nyKHwD1.key_idea: Rank interventions under a selection budget and transfer historical perturbation effects to candidates lacking their own response measurements for learning.
si8nyKHwD1.evidence: CRISPRi Perturb-seq experiments use three held-out cell lines and include Hallmark programme and disease-signature targets.
si8nyKHwD1.claimed_gains: At a budget of 20 selections, normalized utility rises from 0.440 with direct scoring to 0.499 with VCDesign-CED and 0.530 with STRING-neighbor averaging.

LoO9CK0N8Z.one_liner: Global geometric transformations and spatially coherent soft correspondences associate LiDAR instances across time without additional training.
LoO9CK0N8Z.problem: Existing 4D LiDAR panoptic methods process points redundantly and underuse geometric priors while requiring costly training or dedicated association modules.
LoO9CK0N8Z.method: Geo-4D estimates transformations between instance-level point sets and uses global geometry-aware soft matching to enforce coherent correspondences. Its pipeline handles static, dynamic, and missing instances for occlusion-aware matching.
LoO9CK0N8Z.key_idea: Estimate global transformations between instance point sets using spatially coherent soft point correspondences, with separate handling of static, dynamic, and missing instances.
LoO9CK0N8Z.evidence: Experiments evaluate 4D LiDAR panoptic segmentation on SemanticKITTI and nuScenes.

zYaFU7hzKq.one_liner: Temporal reversal and denoising-loss comparisons test video models' time-direction sensitivity separately from causal cognition.
zYaFU7hzKq.problem: Synthetic causal benchmarks limit real-world evaluation, and detecting temporal direction need not demonstrate causal understanding.
zYaFU7hzKq.method: YoCausal reverses real videos to create counterfactual samples and measures time-direction perception through the Reverse Surprise Index. A VLM separates causal and non-causal subsets for a Causality Cognition Index that distinguishes causal sensitivity from temporal bias.
zYaFU7hzKq.key_idea: Reverse real videos, compare denoising losses, and stratify causal versus non-causal content to separate causal cognition from time-direction bias.
zYaFU7hzKq.evidence: Evaluation of 13 video diffusion models reports a gap between time-direction perception and causal cognition relative to humans.

NqIEGtq8Vq.one_liner: Exploration transitions form a view graph that supplies relabeled demonstrations for learning interactive camera control.
NqIEGtq8Vq.problem: VLMs can track supplied camera paths yet rarely compose movements that reach a target view, limiting direct reinforcement learning.
NqIEGtq8Vq.method: ViewSuite evaluates supplied-path understanding and interactive camera control in real 3D scenes. View Graph Distillation joins explored transitions at nearby poses and samples paths with relabeled final-view targets, alternating this supervision with reinforcement learning.
NqIEGtq8Vq.key_idea: Connect explored view transitions at nearby camera poses and relabel sampled path endpoints as targets to construct action demonstrations.
NqIEGtq8Vq.evidence: ViewSuite evaluates 13 VLMs; Qwen2.5-VL-7B training compares direct PPO and GRPO with graph distillation and tests held-out scenes.
NqIEGtq8Vq.claimed_gains: The abstract reports Qwen2.5-VL-7B interactive view-planning success increasing from 2.5% to 47.7%, while direct PPO and GRPO reach 3.2% and 4.9%.

Duy76BICen.one_liner: Epipolar-guided correlations and geometric cross-view attention iteratively refine point trajectories without depth inputs.
Duy76BICen.problem: Multi-view tracking needs to connect 2D correspondences with 3D motion recovery across camera views.
Duy76BICen.method: GeoMVT uses epipolar-guided geometric transform attention to aggregate local correlations, then updates point states with a geometry-guided transformer. Recurrent refinement updates trajectories and subsequent correlation sampling, while triangulation recovers 3D tracks.
Duy76BICen.key_idea: Alternate epipolar-guided correlation aggregation with geometrically aligned cross-view trajectory updates, using refined trajectories to determine subsequent sampling.
Duy76BICen.evidence: Training uses 12K synthetic multi-view Kubric sequences; evaluation spans four benchmarks and different camera configurations, with triangulation-based 3D tracking comparisons.

yitLfD5yIm.one_liner: Dual-timescale attention summaries trigger KV compression or physical-page growth as reasoning demand changes.
yitLfD5yIm.problem: Fixed per-request KV budgets cannot adapt to differences between requests or changing attention demand during generation.
yitLfD5yIm.method: GrowPage estimates evolving attention working sets from recent and long-term query summaries. At capacity boundaries, it compresses within the current allocation or acquires another PagedAttention page while preserving continuous batching and prefix caching.
yitLfD5yIm.key_idea: Compare recent and long-term attention working sets at capacity boundaries to choose between cache compression and additional page allocation.
yitLfD5yIm.evidence: Experiments cover reasoning benchmarks across multiple models and compare performance–throughput trade-offs with existing approaches.

xKY2qlFYET.one_liner: Masked alignment pairs learnable forecast tokens with future exogenous variables, while target-conditioned attention models delayed effects.
xKY2qlFYET.problem: Forecasting methods often fuse future exogenous information with history through heavy architectures that inefficiently model temporal interactions.
xKY2qlFYET.method: NMask associates learnable tokens with future exogenous inputs through Masked Alignment. Target-Conditioned Exogenous Attention captures short-term lags and long-term dependencies for forecasting future endogenous variables.
xKY2qlFYET.key_idea: Align forecast tokens with temporally corresponding future exogenous inputs and condition exogenous attention on targets to model delayed effects.
xKY2qlFYET.evidence: Experiments on multiple unnamed datasets compare forecasting performance, parameter counts, and computation with existing methods using exogenous variables.

OcIwiPVB1B.one_liner: Activation-motion histories drive sequential risk scores that stop unsafe diffusion generations before completion.
OcIwiPVB1B.problem: Prompt filters miss obfuscated intent, post-generation detection pays full sampling cost, and intermediate detectors underuse temporal activation dynamics.
OcIwiPVB1B.method: The method observes activation motion across denoising steps and summarizes its history into accumulated risk. A constrained sequential decision rule stops generation while balancing detection errors and sampling cost.
OcIwiPVB1B.key_idea: Accumulate risk from activation motion across denoising steps and stop generation according to a constrained sequential decision rule.
OcIwiPVB1B.evidence: Experiments span four diffusion backbones and three benchmarks, evaluating in-domain and cross-domain detection.
OcIwiPVB1B.claimed_gains: The method reports relative AUC gains of up to 14.7% over the strongest baseline.

ZA0w5NvsYk.one_liner: Controlled request timing tests how coding agents redirect unfinished repository work when user intentions change.
ZA0w5NvsYk.problem: Repository-level coding benchmarks rarely test changes that arrive during execution and invalidate unfinished plans or edits.
ZA0w5NvsYk.method: CodeInFlight derives interaction instances involving requirement changes, cancellation with replacement, and additional tasks from execution-validated repository tasks. Upfront, Sequential, and In-Flight conditions vary when the same final request appears.
ZA0w5NvsYk.key_idea: Reveal the same final coding request before, after, or during an initial attempt to isolate adaptation to mid-execution changes.
ZA0w5NvsYk.evidence: The benchmark draws on 1,551 tasks across 534 repositories and ten languages, with 287 evaluation instances and comparisons within 21 configurations.
ZA0w5NvsYk.claimed_gains: All eight strong configurations fail 16% more often when changes arrive during execution than when the same changes follow their first attempt.

p9iUCwQasD.one_liner: A vision-language controller iteratively edits and simulates explicit physical scenes before a pretrained model synthesizes video appearance.
p9iUCwQasD.problem: Text-to-video models can render realistic images without ensuring that scene geometry supports interactions or motion follows physical laws.
p9iUCwQasD.method: The framework constructs executable scenes with explicit geometry, materials, physical roles, and simulation parameters. A vision-language controller assesses simulated outcomes, revises scenes through validated edits, and uses resulting geometric priors for video synthesis.
p9iUCwQasD.key_idea: Construct an executable physical world, simulate its dynamics, and iteratively revise scene parameters before rendering priors for appearance synthesis.

IBlHQpc8xU.one_liner: Action-velocity-field distillation uses prefix-weighted trajectory replay to transfer robotic expertise without repeatedly collecting rollouts.
IBlHQpc8xU.problem: Improving target-task performance without degrading pretrained robotic skills is difficult, and on-policy distillation otherwise requires costly fresh environment rollouts.
IBlHQpc8xU.method: RoboOPD distills task-specific teachers through conditional action velocity fields under the student's induced distribution. Prefix-weighted trajectory replay uses a fixed pool dominated by initial-student trajectories and supplemented with teacher rollouts.
IBlHQpc8xU.key_idea: Distill conditional action velocity fields using prefix-weighted replay from a fixed mixture of initial-student and task-specific teacher trajectories.

oLnfsTD6dB.one_liner: Shared-curvature optimization maximizes the worst relative residual reduction across physics-informed objectives.
oLnfsTD6dB.problem: PINN training faces gradient imbalance, conflicting objectives, and ill-conditioned geometry that objective-aware or curvature-only methods do not jointly resolve.
oLnfsTD6dB.method: CHIME chooses multi-objective directions in a shared curvature metric by maximizing worst-case relative first-order residual reduction under a metric-induced step budget. A SOAP-style shared metric and objective-space selection implement the curvature-harmonized direction.
oLnfsTD6dB.key_idea: Maximize the minimum relative first-order residual reduction across objectives under a shared curvature-metric step budget.
oLnfsTD6dB.evidence: A local residual decomposition analyzes objective-wise progress and spectral dispersion; experiments cover four forward PINN benchmarks and a multi-task learning benchmark.
oLnfsTD6dB.claimed_gains: Across four forward PINN benchmarks, CHIME reduces error by geometric mean factors of 5.85× and 5.45× relative to the best objective-aware and curvature-aware baseline for each benchmark, respectively.

dXeFNNkHfm.one_liner: Controlled scene geometry and viewing conditions expose task-specific failures in multi-view 3D spatial reasoning.
dXeFNNkHfm.problem: Existing spatial benchmarks underrepresent diverse viewpoints and vertical scene structure, obscuring VLM behavior across broader 3D configurations.
dXeFNNkHfm.method: DM3SR spans CONTEXTUAL, CONTROLLED-Syn, and CONTROLLED-Real scene families with subtasks for counting, distances, and positional reasoning. Controlled experiments vary vertical spread, viewpoint order, and view count to study cross-view integration.
dXeFNNkHfm.key_idea: Control scene geometry and viewing conditions across spatial subtasks to diagnose how vertical structure and cross-view evidence affect reasoning.
dXeFNNkHfm.evidence: Evaluation covers 32 VLMs and twelve subtasks, examining scaling, spatial adaptation, vertical spread, viewpoint order, and view count.

GeLlax2mLV.one_liner: Source-mapped fan-in cones organize compact dependency context for LLM repair of non-local RTL faults.
GeLlax2mLV.problem: Flat source sequences obscure hardware dataflow, while complete synthesized graphs overwhelm models repairing non-local RTL faults.
GeLlax2mLV.method: GRODE-RTL extracts a suspect register's single-clock-stage fan-in cone and maps netlist nodes to editable source lines. It partitions dependencies by hop, prioritizes direct drivers, and folds distant hops for standard tool-using agents.
GeLlax2mLV.key_idea: Map an anchor register's fan-in cone to source lines and partition dependencies by hop, prioritizing direct drivers while folding distant context.
GeLlax2mLV.evidence: Evaluation uses 30 formally validated faults, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, GLM-5.2, MiniMax-M3, and a controlled six-configuration ablation study.
GeLlax2mLV.claimed_gains: GRODE-RTL improves pass@1 over source-level exploration by 16.7% on DeepSeek, 26.7% on GLM-5.2, and 20.0% on MiniMax-M3.

iQE7BTIGS9.one_liner: Stride-aware rotary positions align latent frames in physical time for variable-rate interactive world-model rollouts.
iQE7BTIGS9.problem: Fixed-rate world models distort perceived evolution when runtime throughput changes and trade temporal detail against physical horizon length.
iQE7BTIGS9.method: RAR uses Stride-RoPE to place frames sampled at different rates on a shared physical-time coordinate. Multi-stride video sampling trains fine dynamics and long-horizon evolution while supporting online rate switches without discarding history.
iQE7BTIGS9.key_idea: Encode latent frames by physical-time coordinates with Stride-RoPE and train across sampling strides to support consistent variable-rate rollouts.
iQE7BTIGS9.evidence: Experiments cover action-controlled and camera-controlled environments, including multi-rate rollout and online rate switching.

wldu663IIA.one_liner: Offline teacher trajectories train LoRA-adapted students to predict flow maps between visited states for few-step generation.
wldu663IIA.problem: Sequential flow-matching inference is slow, while existing distillation can lose teacher-distribution fidelity and visual diversity and require complex training.
wldu663IIA.method: PACT builds an offline bank of teacher generation trajectories and trains a student with LoRA and new time-conditioning inputs. The student predicts flow maps between any two visited states without auxiliary score models.
wldu663IIA.key_idea: Fit flow maps between pairs of states from offline teacher trajectories using LoRA and additional time-conditioning inputs.
wldu663IIA.evidence: Distillation experiments use Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium, LTX-2.3, and MiniMax H3 for image and audiovisual generation.
wldu663IIA.claimed_gains: PACT distills Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium (2.5B), LTX-2.3 (22B), and MiniMax H3 (33B) into 4-step, 8-step, and 4-step generators, respectively, with five-second LTX audiovisual clips generated faster than real time on a single GPU.

Re9Lamu9w3.one_liner: Migration-aware placement and load-driven GPU autoscaling coordinate streaming video sessions under per-chunk latency targets.
Re9Lamu9w3.problem: Long-lived video sessions and bursty active demand make fixed placement and GPU allocation inefficient under tight chunk-latency requirements.
Re9Lamu9w3.method: TurboServe jointly schedules session placement and GPU provisioning with a migration-aware placement controller and a load-driven autoscaling controller. Coalesced chunk processing batches concurrent active sessions on each GPU.
Re9Lamu9w3.key_idea: Rebalance sessions to reduce maximum per-chunk latency while scaling GPU provisioning to changing active-session demand.

TqENu2RW4e.one_liner: Allocates sequence-condition assays via posterior lineage sampling over a hierarchical epistatic model to build diversified mutation trees.
TqENu2RW4e.problem: Single-sequence protein optimization ignores shared lineage construction budgets across related conditions and exposes condition-wise surrogate maximization to the optimizer's curse.
TqENu2RW4e.method: EGRET formulates assay-limited generalist-to-specialist diversification from a common scaffold and uses a hierarchical epistatic posterior with posterior lineage sampling to allocate limited sequence-condition measurements. It commits a final rooted mutation tree using measured leaf-condition utilities to provide a verifiable lower bound on value.
TqENu2RW4e.key_idea: Allocates sequence-condition assays through posterior lineage sampling over a hierarchical epistatic model and commits rooted mutation trees using measured leaf-condition utilities.
TqENu2RW4e.evidence: Evaluated on twenty finite-library protein sequence design instances, including comparisons with a prespecified condition niche and unmeasured-cell explanation methods.
TqENu2RW4e.claimed_gains: Achieves the highest score on 17 of twenty finite-library instances, with its measured-only score nearly equaling its realized score.

LXQzlI09cU.one_liner: Integrates five atomic context-editing operations into an agentic reasoning-and-tool loop to dynamically manage long-horizon search context.
LXQzlI09cU.problem: Naively accumulating all intermediate reasoning and tool outputs in long-horizon search agents overwhelms the working context, increasing computational costs and error rates.
LXQzlI09cU.method: Context-ReAct unifies reasoning, tool calls, and adaptive context management through five atomic operations—Skip, Compress, Rollback, Snippet, and Delete—spanning abstractive compression, exact extraction, deletion, and structural rollback. LongSeeker instantiates this framework by fine-tuning Qwen3-30B-A3B on 10k synthesized trajectories.
LXQzlI09cU.key_idea: Embeds Skip, Compress, Rollback, Snippet, and Delete operations directly into the ReAct reasoning-and-tool loop to adaptively reshape trajectory detail.
LXQzlI09cU.evidence: Evaluated LongSeeker (fine-tuned from Qwen3-30B-A3B on 10k synthesized trajectories) across four search benchmarks including BrowseComp and BrowseComp-ZH against Tongyi DeepResearch.
LXQzlI09cU.claimed_gains: LongSeeker achieves 61.5% on BrowseComp and 62.5% on BrowseComp-ZH, outperforming Tongyi DeepResearch (43.4%).

V6sCud3xDW.one_liner: Represents environment dynamics for frozen LLM agents as falsifiable hypotheses validated by live experiments and narrowed by counterexamples.
V6sCud3xDW.problem: Self-evolving LLM agents fail when their beliefs about environment dynamics are incomplete, incorrect, or outdated, and unverified beliefs can propagate errors across tasks.
V6sCud3xDW.method: Keeping the base language model frozen, EvoBelief triggers hypothesis formation from unexpected outcomes or decision-relevant unknowns and requires independent validation via observations and live controlled experiments before rules guide planning. Counterexamples narrow or retire rules as dynamics shift, while linking every rule to its supporting evidence and affected decisions.
V6sCud3xDW.key_idea: Formulates environment rules as scope-bounded falsifiable hypotheses triggered by unexpected outcomes, validated via independent observations and live experiments, and narrowed upon counterexamples.
V6sCud3xDW.evidence: Evaluated across four benchmarks spanning static dynamics, hidden drift, and scientific discovery, including ALFWorld (with Claude Haiku 4.5 and GPT-5.4 against a Frozen WM control) and MiniGrid.
V6sCud3xDW.claimed_gains: On ALFWorld without actor-side transition memory, improves task success over the matched Frozen WM control by 23.9 and 31.3 percentage points with Claude Haiku 4.5 and GPT-5.4, respectively.

7n2EsvQZWu.one_liner: Optimizes coupled analog circuit constraints, placement, and routing via a multimodal LLM over an executable B* Graph.
7n2EsvQZWu.problem: Stage-by-stage analog physical design automation optimizes placement and routing separately, leaving downstream parasitic and electrical failures unreconciled with earlier layout decisions.
7n2EsvQZWu.method: LAMBDA unifies analog constraints, device placement, and routing in a customized executable B* Graph search space optimized by a multimodal LLM using circuit knowledge, layout observations, and accumulated experience. Multi-fidelity optimization combines low-cost physical and parasitic models with detailed post-layout electrical evaluation feedback.
7n2EsvQZWu.key_idea: Unifies analog constraints, placement, and routing in an executable B* Graph steered by a multimodal LLM with multi-fidelity parasitic and electrical feedback.
7n2EsvQZWu.evidence: Evaluated on nine commercial 28-nm analog circuits measuring geometric mean full layout area, wirelength, and a composite analog electrical score.

GDxcnGBaWc.one_liner: Unifies image synthesis and variable-length text generation in continuous velocity fields via a regularized Text VAE and blockwise flow.
GDxcnGBaWc.problem: Pretrained text-to-image continuous flow models cannot natively generate variable-length text responses alongside images within a shared continuous latent velocity field.
GDxcnGBaWc.method: CoUPLe decouples text conditioning from text generation by pairing a frozen reference encoder and learned connector with a Text VAE jointly adapted under reconstruction and reference-posterior KL regularization. Causal blockwise flow matching generates latent blocks autoregressively with parallel refinement inside each block, treating image synthesis as a single image-latent block.
GDxcnGBaWc.key_idea: Decouples frozen text conditioning from a KL-regularized Text VAE and applies causal blockwise flow matching across autoregressive latent blocks with parallel intra-block refinement.
GDxcnGBaWc.evidence: Instantiated on Flux2-9B and Z-Image across MM-DiT and single-stream DiT architectures, evaluated on visual understanding, multimodal reasoning, and instruction-guided image editing.

ltTuGRiZyD.one_liner: Solves diffusion inverse problems via low-to-full-band frequency-weighted Langevin refinement paired with a coarse-to-fine Haar-domain commitment rule.
ltTuGRiZyD.problem: In diffusion posterior sampling at high noise levels, clean-estimate errors corrupt full-band measurement guidance while stochastic refinement alters fine details weakly constrained by measurements.
ltTuGRiZyD.method: The authors propose a posterior continuation framework whose noise-conditioned likelihoods emphasize low-frequency measurement residuals early and gradually return to full-band consistency. Their stabilized sampler combines a diffusion predictor, frequency-weighted Langevin refinement, and a Haar-domain commitment rule that adopts coarse corrections fully while progressively admitting detail corrections.
ltTuGRiZyD.key_idea: Constructs intermediate posteriors emphasizing low-frequency residuals first, combining frequency-weighted Langevin refinement with a Haar-domain rule that commits coarse updates before fine details.
ltTuGRiZyD.evidence: Evaluated across super-resolution, inpainting, and motion deblurring restoration benchmarks against diffusion inverse-problem baselines.
ltTuGRiZyD.claimed_gains: Achieves PSNR gains exceeding 5 dB on motion deblurring against the strongest evaluated baselines.

y1BGyTSdkN.one_liner: Adapts frozen pretrained event encoders across diverse representations via feature alignment and operator-conditioned input projections with low-rank updates.
y1BGyTSdkN.problem: Pretrained event-based vision encoders suffer from representation lock-in, where changing the input event representation degrades downstream accuracy even on the same event stream.
y1BGyTSdkN.method: Omnivorous Event Encoder (OmniE²) adapts pretrained event encoders across diverse representations using global and dense feature alignment while keeping the backbone frozen. For unseen representations, its Cross-Representation Adapter uses a shared operator-conditioned generator to produce native input projections and low-rank corrections to early Transformer blocks.
y1BGyTSdkN.key_idea: Uses a shared operator-conditioned generator to synthesize representation-specific input projections and early Transformer low-rank corrections aligned via global and dense feature supervision.
y1BGyTSdkN.evidence: Evaluated across diverse seen and unseen event representations and datasets on downstream tasks including semantic segmentation and object-level tasks.

osF45Sn3tO.one_liner: Weights stochastic velocity updates by normalized mean-one target-to-behavior endpoint density ratios for rescaling-invariant flow-model reward tuning.
osF45Sn3tO.problem: Forward-process reward tuning for flow models suffers from coefficient ambiguity, where distinct positive endpoint weights defining the same target distribution produce different stochastic velocity updates.
osF45Sn3tO.method: ROOT resolves coefficient ambiguity by using the unique mean-one target-to-behavior endpoint density ratio as a condition-wise rescaling-invariant coefficient for stochastic velocity training. It pairs a single-pass behavior-centered finite-tilt objective (RootSolve) with multi-pass rollout reuse via moving-reference updates (RootTrace) that remove pull toward original behavior predictions.
osF45Sn3tO.key_idea: Uses the unique mean-one target-to-behavior endpoint density ratio for stochastic velocity training alongside moving-reference multi-pass rollout updates.
osF45Sn3tO.evidence: Supported by population optimality analysis and reward-tuning experiments on Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium compared against DiffusionNFT in single-pass and multi-pass settings.
osF45Sn3tO.claimed_gains: On Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium, reaches matched DiffusionNFT training-reward thresholds with 2.2–3.4x and 10–20x fewer outer iterations across single- and multi-pass optimization.

92SEw5FtLg.one_liner: Compresses video streams into a multi-slot associative state and steers frozen VLM prompt prefixes via query-conditioned K/V modulations.
92SEw5FtLg.problem: Long-video understanding under strict token budgets typically relies on lossy frame compression, appended memory tokens, or direct edits to internal visual KV caches.
92SEw5FtLg.method: Prefix-Steered Recurrent Memory (PReM) decouples video ingestion from querying in frozen VLMs using a recurrent writer that distills visual streams into an ≈256 KiB multi-slot associative state. At query time, a question-conditioned readout injects memory-derived key/value steering modulations into existing non-visual prompt prefixes during prefill without extra tokens.
92SEw5FtLg.key_idea: Distills video into a compact recurrent associative memory and injects question-conditioned key/value modulations into non-visual prompt prefixes during prefill.
92SEw5FtLg.evidence: Evaluated across six long-video benchmarks in offline and streaming end-of-stream settings, including frozen Qwen2.5-VL-3B under a 16-frame budget.
92SEw5FtLg.claimed_gains: Under a 16-frame budget on Qwen2.5-VL-3B, improves macro-average accuracy by 3.06% (with 11.0% gain on action antonym identification and 9.9% on localized needle retrieval) while adding ≈0.45% backbone parameters and 0.03 GiB peak GPU memory overhead.

ei2gvMahik.one_liner: Attention-perturbation teacher contrasts and non-conflicting directional projection guide few-step distribution matching distillation for human-object interaction video.
ei2gvMahik.problem: Few-step diffusion distillation struggles to simultaneously preserve plausible human-object interaction dynamics and reference product visual consistency in video generation.
ei2gvMahik.method: Attention Perturbation selectively enables or blocks target-video queries' access to conditioning keys and values in the teacher, pairing a student-predicted HOI enhancement response with a product-reference preservation contrast. A one-sided projection removes enhancement components that oppose the product-preservation direction before augmenting the Distribution Matching Distillation target, trained on the curated InteractVerse dataset.
ei2gvMahik.key_idea: Contrast teacher predictions under selective conditioning-attention masking and project out interaction-guidance components that oppose product-reference preservation during distribution matching distillation.
ei2gvMahik.evidence: Evaluated via experiments and ablations against vanilla Distribution Matching Distillation using the curated livestream-based InteractVerse multimodal HOI dataset.

WLraJGElkM.one_liner: Characterizes minimax pseudo-regret in d-dimensional Lipschitz bandits jointly constrained by W memory bits and B batches.
WLraJGElkM.problem: Prior Lipschitz bandit analyses establish near-optimal regret under either small memory with full adaptivity or few batches with unrestricted memory, leaving joint memory-and-batch constraints uncharacterized.
WLraJGElkM.method: The paper derives minimax expected pseudo-regret lower and upper bounds over T rounds in dimension d under a W-bit memory limit and at most B batches. Its analysis separates fine-scale arm comparisons from the regional information needed to allocate samples across fixed or adaptive batch boundaries.
WLraJGElkM.key_idea: Separate fine-scale arm comparisons from regional sample-allocation information to derive matching memory-batch lower bounds and fixed-boundary upper bounds.
WLraJGElkM.evidence: Theoretical minimax lower and upper bounds characterize pseudo-regret across general memory budgets W, batch limits B, and 1-bit adaptive versus fixed batch boundaries.

QKkw0awjMW.one_liner: Weights flow-matching velocity residuals by terminal-transported geometry that maps current error directions to final output changes.
QKkw0awjMW.problem: Standard flow matching penalizes equal-norm local velocity errors equally even when remaining generation dynamics map those directions to unequal changes in the final output.
QKkw0awjMW.method: ImpactFlow introduces terminal-transported residual geometry to relate local velocity error directions at intermediate states to their predicted impact on completed outputs. It applies directional residual weighting during flow-matching training while keeping the original conditional velocity targets and inference procedure unchanged.
QKkw0awjMW.key_idea: Weight local flow-matching velocity errors according to how remaining generation dynamics transport error directions into relevant terminal output changes.
QKkw0awjMW.evidence: Evaluated on low-step HumanML3D and KIT-ML text-to-motion generation against decoder-only geometry, endpoint geometry with matched scalar training strength, Standard FM, and Shortcut.

QrVhQvM6H2.one_liner: Evaluates long-horizon interactive world models across action accuracy, sliding-window visual drift, gated physics checks, and trajectory-aware memory.
QrVhQvM6H2.problem: Existing evaluations insufficiently measure whether interactive world models remain stable, physically plausible, and memory-consistent under sustained long-horizon action inputs.
QrVhQvM6H2.method: WorldRoamBench evaluates continuous 10-60 second WASD interactions across four dimensions: pose-based discrete-action accuracy, sliding-window visual drift, camera- and tracking-gated physical plausibility, and trajectory-aware 3D point-cloud and VLM-tracked memory.
QrVhQvM6H2.key_idea: Measure sustained interactive world-model stability across discrete pose actions, sliding-window drift, motion-gated physics checks, and 3D/tracking memory protocols.
QrVhQvM6H2.evidence: Benchmarks 12 open- and closed-source interactive world models over more than 1,000 test cases spanning Nature, Urban, and Indoor scenes in first- and third-person views.
QrVhQvM6H2.claimed_gains: Across 12 evaluated models, none reliably satisfies all four dimensions, and the highest long-horizon first-person overall score is 67.17/100 (Genie 3).

Radj1Kb5YH.one_liner: Adapts an SMLM training simulator using a spatial emitter distribution fitted across real frames alongside self-calibrated imaging parameters.
Radj1Kb5YH.problem: Conventional single-molecule localization microscopy methods process short frame windows independently, ignoring the shared 3D specimen structure across the full acquisition.
Radj1Kb5YH.method: A neural network trains on simulated microscopy frames to detect and localize fluorophores while fitting a spatial density over predicted localizations on real frames and jointly estimating the point spread function, background, and photophysics. The fitted emitter distribution and calibrated parameters iteratively update the simulator during training and yield a continuous super-resolved density representation.
Radj1Kb5YH.key_idea: Fit a global emitter spatial density and imaging parameters on real frames to iteratively adapt the localization network's training simulator.
Radj1Kb5YH.evidence: Tested on synthetic benchmarks against the same network architecture trained with uniformly distributed emitters (further empirical details are truncated in the abstract).

u27O2KAT7y.one_liner: Factorizes physics-constrained generation into free-coordinate distributional progression and offline physics completion distilled into a transition recovery network.
u27O2KAT7y.problem: Balancing generative losses against physical constraints during training or correcting samples online at inference creates trade-offs among distributional fidelity, physical consistency, and compute cost.
u27O2KAT7y.method: Physics-Aligned Finite Maps (PAFM) advances samples toward the target distribution in free physical coordinates along a coarse-to-fine heat bridge while completing each step into a physically feasible full field to form compatible next-state teacher targets. It also distills offline physical completion into a lightweight transition recovery network to suppress rollout drift without online physical solves.
u27O2KAT7y.key_idea: Advance samples in free coordinates along a coarse-to-fine heat bridge while completing feasible fields offline and distilling transition recovery.
u27O2KAT7y.evidence: Empirical evaluation is truncated in the abstract after introducing the coarse-to-fine heat bridge and distilled transition recovery network.

tsaVaXekAU.one_liner: Joint action and camera-pose prediction propagates geometric state for vision-language navigation.
tsaVaXekAU.problem: Existing navigation methods model memory, state-aware reasoning, and future prediction separately, leaving navigation state evolution disconnected across time.
tsaVaXekAU.method: PoseVLN organizes visual memory and current observations in an episode-relative coordinate frame and jointly predicts the next K actions and a local DeltaPose. It composes DeltaPose with trajectory-level pose and recursively propagates the resulting future pose throughout navigation.
tsaVaXekAU.key_idea: Recursively compose predicted local DeltaPose with trajectory pose to connect visual memory, current state, and future motion geometrically.
tsaVaXekAU.evidence: Experiments on the R2R-CE and RxR-CE Val-Unseen splits compare PoseVLN with navigation baselines using success rate.
tsaVaXekAU.claimed_gains: PoseVLN outperforms the strongest compared baselines by 2.6 and 2.9 percentage points in success rate on R2R-CE and RxR-CE Val-Unseen, respectively.

Ph4kseQSdG.one_liner: Compositional diffusion guidance edits molecular latents toward target phenotypes while preserving seed-structure similarity.
Ph4kseQSdG.problem: Existing phenotype-guided molecular generation cannot precisely reach desired biological signatures while remaining close to a known hit.
Ph4kseQSdG.method: PhAME performs molecular editing in the latent space of a pretrained graph-based VAE using latent diffusion. Its compositional classifier-free guidance has independent scales for the target signature and seed-structure similarity.
Ph4kseQSdG.key_idea: Independently scale phenotype guidance and seed-similarity guidance during latent diffusion to control their tradeoff.
Ph4kseQSdG.evidence: Empirical evaluations cover docking score optimization and multimodal phenotypic generation, with measurements of chemical validity and novelty.

AU1JMnA2cK.one_liner: Budget-varied reinforcement learning improves long-horizon agent robustness across changing interaction constraints.
AU1JMnA2cK.problem: Multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning gains depend heavily on interaction budgets and do not uniformly improve single-step decisions.
AU1JMnA2cK.method: The paper evaluates agents across sampling breadth K and interaction depth T using Pass@(K,T), then introduces BudgetMix RL, which varies interaction budgets during training. It also discusses process supervision as a way to address budget dependence.
AU1JMnA2cK.key_idea: Vary interaction budgets during reinforcement learning so agents learn error recovery and long-horizon resilience across execution regimes.
AU1JMnA2cK.evidence: Experiments vary sampling breadth and interaction depth and evaluate BudgetMix RL across diverse execution settings.

gpL5ZAN98s.one_liner: State-forked preferences train language models to revise or preserve answers according to conversational state.
gpL5ZAN98s.problem: Errors can self-excite through conversation history, while robust models must recover from mistakes without unnecessarily changing correct answers.
gpL5ZAN98s.method: SF-DPO forks a fixed conversation state into preferred and rejected continuations for recovery, stability, valid-evidence updating, and fabricated-evidence resistance. It optimizes these preferences with DPO and chosen-response anchoring.
gpL5ZAN98s.key_idea: Construct state-dependent preference pairs from four complementary revision behaviors and optimize them with anchored DPO.
gpL5ZAN98s.evidence: Evaluation spans three benchmarks and 33 model configurations from seven model groups with approximately 0.5B to 32B parameters.

PvjHjh43y3.one_liner: Dependency-aware contracts combine code inspection, replay, and playtesting to evaluate specification-faithful game generation.
PvjHjh43y3.problem: Existing game-development benchmarks use compact specifications and poorly evaluate interdependent requirements in long-form design documents.
PvjHjh43y3.method: A2Z GameSpec-Bench converts each of 100 long-form GDDs into a fixed Dependency-Aware Contract containing rules, constraints, and prerequisite relations. It combines source-code inspection with agent-generated Test Policies for scenario replay and adaptive playtesting, linking judgments and evidence to requirements.
PvjHjh43y3.key_idea: Evaluate games against fixed dependency-aware requirement contracts using linked source, replay, and playtest evidence.
PvjHjh43y3.evidence: The benchmark evaluates end-to-end coding agents on 100 long-form GDDs and supports comparisons across agents and revision rounds.

1wzZKjjzFN.one_liner: Grounded visual reasoning produces pixel goals that geometric planners convert into navigation actions.
1wzZKjjzFN.problem: Vision-language navigation agents struggle to connect semantic reasoning with spatial execution because reasoning lacks visual grounding and decisions lack precise goals.
1wzZKjjzFN.method: GroundingVLN anchors task-relevant visual evidence to image locations during structured reasoning and predicts progress-aligned pixel goals for a geometric planner. It trains with GroundingCOTVLN-188K grounded reasoning traces and Grounded and Execution-Aware Reinforcement Learning.
1wzZKjjzFN.key_idea: Use visual grounding as a shared interface that connects image-anchored reasoning to pixel goals and primitive actions.
1wzZKjjzFN.evidence: Experiments evaluate GroundingVLN on R2R-CE and RxR-CE using success rate after training with grounded reasoning and execution-aware reinforcement learning.
1wzZKjjzFN.claimed_gains: GroundingVLN achieves 69.9% SR on R2R-CE and 75.1% SR on RxR-CE.

p4VlzhrlDq.one_liner: Cross-branch semantic steering probes representational compatibility between multimodal understanding and generation.
p4VlzhrlDq.problem: Separate evaluations of understanding and generation reveal little about whether their internal semantic representations are compatible in unified multimodal models.
p4VlzhrlDq.method: The framework extracts semantic directions from one branch of a unified multimodal model and applies them to the other. It compares understanding-to-generation and generation-to-understanding interventions to diagnose representational transfer.
p4VlzhrlDq.key_idea: Intervene across model branches with extracted semantic vectors to test whether their internal representations transfer.
p4VlzhrlDq.evidence: Bidirectional steering experiments show effective understanding-to-generation transfer but limited reverse transfer, with analysis of object-centric semantics and low-level appearance features.

q7xUYM0Ucb.one_liner: Benchmarks seven visual in-context learning models across 14 datasets, 12 tasks, and 106 combinations in a unified one-shot protocol.
q7xUYM0Ucb.problem: Prior visual in-context learning evaluations focus on narrow domains and tasks that mirror pre-training, obscuring true test-time adaptation.
q7xUYM0Ucb.method: The authors construct the VIBE benchmark spanning diverse imaging domains and tasks and evaluate seven visual in-context learning models under a unified one-shot protocol.
q7xUYM0Ucb.key_idea: Stress-tests one-shot test-time adaptation of visual in-context learners across 106 out-of-domain dataset-task combinations.
q7xUYM0Ucb.evidence: Unified one-shot evaluation of seven visual in-context learning models across 14 datasets and 12 tasks (106 combinations).

gKHAMfD4mn.one_liner: Replaces flat CUA workspace memory with hierarchical trust zones so external claims persist without gaining action-guiding authority.
gKHAMfD4mn.problem: Flat persistent memory in OpenClaw-style computer-use agents grants stored external claims the same authority as user instructions, enabling cross-session persistent memory attacks.
gKHAMfD4mn.method: ZoneClaw partitions workspace memory into hierarchical trust zones with asymmetric-privilege processes, isolating external claims in a low-trust zone and requiring cross-checked promotion across an authority boundary.
gKHAMfD4mn.key_idea: Separates persistence from authority by zoning CUA workspace memory and gating promotion across trust boundaries with asymmetric-privilege checks.

BLkY95W2BI.one_liner: Probes the hidden state immediately after a teacher-forced empty-reasoning boundary to predict answer correctness before decoding.
BLkY95W2BI.problem: Pre-answer uncertainty probes typically read the final query token, missing stronger correctness signals formed after reasoning-template boundaries.
BLkY95W2BI.method: THINKUQ appends a fixed teacher-forced empty-reasoning suffix with zero decoding and trains a lightweight correctness probe on the resulting hidden state.
BLkY95W2BI.key_idea: Reads a correctness probe from the hidden state right after a teacher-forced empty-reasoning boundary with zero decoding.
BLkY95W2BI.evidence: Evaluations across four Qwen3 scales on factual recall, arithmetic, and code, including MMLU, MMLU-Pro, prequential codelength, and CoT training trajectory analyses.
BLkY95W2BI.claimed_gains: On Qwen3-4B, improves subject-OOD MMLU AUROC by 9.95 points.

kd55TEsmFk.one_liner: Detects physical danger in LLM hidden states using linear probes and a rank-16 bridge to close the verbalization gap.
kd55TEsmFk.problem: LLMs distinguish physical danger from content danger internally but fail to verbalize physical risks, causing unsafe physical actions on seemingly benign instructions.
kd55TEsmFk.method: The authors probe hidden states across six LLMs to separate content danger and physical danger directions, introduce PRISM as a lightweight hidden-state detector, and construct PD-Bench. They also train a rank-16 bridge into the final decoder block without modifying base weights.
kd55TEsmFk.key_idea: Uses linear probes on LLM hidden states to separate physical danger from content danger and a rank-16 decoder bridge to transfer that signal to verbal outputs.
kd55TEsmFk.evidence: Evaluated across six LLMs (1.7B–32B parameters) from three families on four benchmarks plus the newly constructed PD-Bench.
kd55TEsmFk.claimed_gains: Linear hidden-state readouts outperform verbal judgments by 0.03–0.30 AUC across four benchmarks (p=0.001), while a rank-16 bridge recovers 24–75% of the probe-verbal gap on PD-Bench and halves false positives.

Hmj6QYzDZY.one_liner: Replaces pretrained 3D point encoders with alignment-free patch tokenization, decoupled point-text LoRA, and program-supervised tool reasoning.
Hmj6QYzDZY.problem: Pretrained 3D point encoders impose a representation bottleneck, while single-pass closed-book generation prevents active spatial inspection or external retrieval.
Hmj6QYzDZY.method: PointTool introduces Alignment-Free Patch Tokenization (AFPT) for raw point clouds, Decoupled Point-Text LoRA (DPL) inside a frozen LLM, Program-Supervised Tool Reasoning (PSTR) for executable 3D tools, and the PointCloud-TR benchmark.
Hmj6QYzDZY.key_idea: Feeds raw point-cloud patches directly into a frozen LLM via decoupled LoRA and executable 3D inspection tools rather than a pretrained 3D encoder.
Hmj6QYzDZY.evidence: Introduces PointCloud-TR (13K 3D objects, 39.8K questions, 35.6K tool trajectories) and evaluates 3D reasoning performance.

56zdllpmri.one_liner: Introduces VideoMemBench, a multi-turn video dialogue benchmark testing cross-turn episodic and answer memory dependencies.
56zdllpmri.problem: Existing video QA benchmarks use independent questions answerable from the video alone, leaving multi-turn in-context video memory unmeasured.
56zdllpmri.method: VideoMemBench pairs single videos with long multi-turn dialogues linked by typed Episodic Dependencies (prior visual episodes) and Answer Dependencies (prior model answers). A three-role LLM pipeline (planner, generator, and verifier) enforces that each dependent question is necessary and non-leaking.
56zdllpmri.key_idea: Constructs multi-turn video dialogues with verified necessary, non-leaking episodic and answer dependencies across turns via a three-role LLM pipeline.
56zdllpmri.evidence: Evaluated via the VideoMemBench construction and verification pipeline; specific model evaluation numbers are not stated in the abstract.

LVVypiqKgt.one_liner: Maps radio-frequency sensor measurements into the latent space of a frozen visual generative perception model.
LVVypiqKgt.problem: Non-visual sensors like RF lack internet-scale datasets and currently require separate pretraining or per-task distillation for each perception task.
LVVypiqKgt.method: RFception trains a lightweight interface that projects RF signals into the latent space of a text-prompted pretrained visual generative perception model, enabling multi-task and VLM-compatible outputs.
LVVypiqKgt.key_idea: Adapts RF measurements into a pretrained visual generative model's latent space so text prompts select multiple geometric and semantic tasks.
LVVypiqKgt.evidence: Experiments across six held-out buildings on depth estimation and zero-shot surface-normal, human pose, and instance segmentation tasks.

XMSWSfHwMB.one_liner: Pretrains an audio Transformer solely by autoregressively predicting next log-mel spectrogram patch embeddings with stop-gradient.
XMSWSfHwMB.problem: Self-supervised audio learners increasingly rely on complex pipelines with reconstruction decoders, acoustic tokenizers, or student-teacher setups.
XMSWSfHwMB.method: NAPE trains a causal Transformer to predict each next patch embedding of a log-mel spectrogram from preceding patches using a causal mask and stop-gradient as the sole training signal.
XMSWSfHwMB.key_idea: Uses minimalist causal next-patch-embedding prediction with stop-gradient on log-mel spectrograms without decoders, tokenizers, or teacher networks.
XMSWSfHwMB.evidence: Evaluations across six audio and speech benchmarks.

A8t2eWy3Le.one_liner: Decouples execution chunk length from multi-step critic-evaluated policy-update horizons in an autoregressive Transformer SAC agent.
A8t2eWy3Le.problem: Action-chunking off-policy RL methods tie execution chunk length to optimization horizon rather than optimizing longer multi-chunk action sequences.
A8t2eWy3Le.method: HOPS extends T-SAC with a compact Policy Transformer that recursively generates action chunks conditioned on initial state and prior actions, evaluated by twin prefix-conditioned critics over an independent update horizon.
A8t2eWy3Le.key_idea: Evaluates recursively generated multi-chunk action sequences with twin prefix-conditioned critics over an update horizon decoupled from execution chunk size.
A8t2eWy3Le.evidence: Online training from scratch on all 50 Meta-World ML1 tasks (with critic-guided BoN) and FANCY GYM Box Pushing.
A8t2eWy3Le.claimed_gains: On Meta-World at 5x10^6 interactions, HOPS achieves 0.938 success IQM versus 0.848 for T-SAC (0.881 vs. 0.736 at 2M in TLDR); on Box Pushing at 8x10^6 interactions, HOPS reaches 0.941 IQM versus 0.637 for T-SAC.

VUkV0HYxPo.one_liner: Solves two confidence games on one learned low-rank Markov game model and crosses their policies to certify Nash equilibria.
VUkV0HYxPo.problem: Equilibria computed from a learned Markov game model can still admit profitable unilateral deviations in the true environment.
VUkV0HYxPo.method: The algorithm constructs lower and upper confidence games from a single learned low-rank transition model, pairs the lower-max with upper-min policy for equilibrium certification, and uses the reverse pairing to drive exploration.
VUkV0HYxPo.key_idea: Crosses maximizing and minimizing policies between lower and upper confidence games on one model to both minimize the deviation certificate and explore.
VUkV0HYxPo.evidence: High-probability finite-sample interaction upper bounds under realizability and experiments separating certificate tightness from policy quality.
VUkV0HYxPo.claimed_gains: Achieves an epsilon-Nash pair in O_tilde(d^2 J (J + d^2) / ((1 - gamma)^4 epsilon^2)) outer iterations with reset access (plus (1 - gamma)^(-1) for primitive transitions).

vrMFDm86FA.one_liner: Introduces a 200K-turn training corpus, benchmark, and streaming omnimodal model for spoken queries embedded inside audio-visual streams.
vrMFDm86FA.problem: Streaming omnimodal models typically receive user queries as separate explicit inputs rather than recognizing them naturally within continuous audio-visual streams.
vrMFDm86FA.method: The authors construct NativeQuery-Train (200K turns) and NativeQuery-Bench (3,419 turns across 5 task families) by embedding native-speaker spoken queries into audio-visual streams, and train NativeStream on this corpus.
vrMFDm86FA.key_idea: Embeds native spoken queries directly into continuous audio-visual streams to train and benchmark in-stream omnimodal interaction.
vrMFDm86FA.evidence: Benchmarking on NativeQuery-Bench comparing explicit text queries against in-stream spoken queries across five task families and fifteen subtasks.

cfmMp2xvbk.one_liner: Generates rare-disease clinical case reports via hierarchical patient-data mining and iterative tool-integrated literature querying.
cfmMp2xvbk.problem: LLMs struggle to produce rigorous, evidence-based reasoning required for unprecedented, atypical, and rare disease clinical case reports.
cfmMp2xvbk.method: MedCaseAgent uses a modular hierarchical agentic framework combining patient-level data mining with iterative tool-integrated queries to medical literature and knowledge bases. They also release MedCase-150K, MedCase-Bench, and a post-trained Qwen3.5-9B model.
cfmMp2xvbk.key_idea: Couples patient-level data mining with iterative tool-integrated queries to medical literature and knowledge bases in a hierarchical agent.
cfmMp2xvbk.evidence: Evaluated on the temporally held-out MedCase-Bench using LLM-judged, rule-based, blinded expert reviews, and ablations across general and medical LLMs.

9ut68LbHTI.one_liner: Coordinates visual multi-agent systems by modulating shared visual Value states with a geometric consensus of agents' visual attention.
9ut68LbHTI.problem: Latent visual multi-agent systems propagate intermediate reasoning KV states without coordinating which visual regions different role-conditioned agents attend to.
9ut68LbHTI.method: V-Guide spatially marginalizes role-conditioned visual attention maps over a shared visual KV cache, aggregates them into a geometric consensus distribution, and uses this consensus to modulate the shared visual Value states in a training-free manner.
9ut68LbHTI.key_idea: Aggregates spatially marginalized role-conditioned visual attention maps into a geometric consensus distribution that reweights shared visual Value states without training.

B2R4zc24DD.one_liner: Uses an LLM to select among diverse HPO proposers while co-designing the optimization loop for wall-clock efficiency.
B2R4zc24DD.problem: Using an LLM as a standalone hyperparameter optimizer suffers from single-prior inductive bias and serial LLM latency overhead.
B2R4zc24DD.method: ASAP uses an LLM agent to integrate and select proposals from a diverse pool of inductive-biased HPO optimizers each round while re-architecting the execution loop to minimize wall-clock overhead.
B2R4zc24DD.key_idea: Pairs LLM-based selection across heterogeneous HPO proposers with an asynchronous/co-designed loop to reduce wall-clock budget.

amtbxfmMu8.one_liner: Factorizes dynamic latent residuals into shared motion bases over a frozen static NVS backbone for spacetime rendering.
amtbxfmMu8.problem: Feed-forward dynamic novel view synthesis methods rely on explicit 4D representations tied to specific capture setups and auxiliary annotations.
amtbxfmMu8.method: AnySpaceTime freezes a pretrained static NVS latent backbone and adds a lightweight motion branch that factorizes target-time latent residuals into scene-shared motion bases and source-local coefficients. Updated latents are rendered from target poses via a LoRA-adapted decoder trained only with RGB supervision.
amtbxfmMu8.key_idea: Keeps a static NVS latent backbone and factorizes temporal residuals into scene-shared motion bases and source-local coefficients, rendered via a LoRA-adapted decoder.
amtbxfmMu8.evidence: Trained with RGB supervision alone and evaluated across monocular, synchronous, and asynchronous multi-view dynamic scene benchmarks.

X50woG5aDs.one_liner: Decouples cooperative feature admission from identity tracking across CSA, URA, and CPIA modules for 3D MOT.
X50woG5aDs.problem: Sharing matching decisions between cross-agent feature fusion and identity inheritance causes appearance/misalignment errors to corrupt both tracking and fusion.
X50woG5aDs.method: FFBL-Coop separates feature fusion from identity binding using Confidence-ranked Slot Admission (CSA), Unified Representation Aggregation (URA) inside a shared transformer decoder, and Cooperative-Priority Identity Anchoring (CPIA) for cross-frame track assignment, plus a shared codebook for payload compression.
X50woG5aDs.key_idea: Fuses cooperative features into ego slots first via confidence-ranked admission and decoder refinement, then binds persistent identities afterward.
X50woG5aDs.evidence: Evaluated on V2X-Seq and Griffin-25M cooperative 3D multi-object tracking benchmarks.
X50woG5aDs.claimed_gains: Achieves AMOTA/AP of 0.611/0.548 on V2X-Seq and 0.688/0.653 on Griffin-25M.

aj2ODvryRp.one_liner: Stylizes text-to-motion generation at inference by combining dataset, instance, and frozen generator priors on velocity/score.
aj2ODvryRp.problem: Paired motion data in different styles are scarce, and editing styles in pretrained text-to-motion generators often conflicts with motion content and quality.
aj2ODvryRp.method: TriPrior operates at inference time on frozen flow or diffusion motion generators by correcting velocity or score predictions using three priors: a dataset-level style direction, an instance-level adapted style prior, and the generator's own content-conditioned response to the edited state.
aj2ODvryRp.key_idea: Corrects frozen diffusion or flow motion-generator predictions at inference by combining dataset-level, instance-level, and generator content-preserving priors.
aj2ODvryRp.evidence: Evaluations on HumanML3D with style-motion input across HY-Motion, HY-Lite, and Kimodo, plus controlled ablations.
aj2ODvryRp.claimed_gains: On HumanML3D, TriPrior on HY-Motion achieves 29.40% SRA-4 style accuracy and 38.70% content-retrieval R@1, exceeding MoMo and MLD+Aberman by 3.06 and 11.32 percentage points, respectively.

dVv1MBkavP.one_liner: Continually adapts frozen-weight agents via guarded harness evolution checking improvement, retention, and validity before commitment.
dVv1MBkavP.problem: Updating an agent's external harness of prompts, memories, tools, skills, and routing rules can cause harness-level forgetting of previously reliable behaviors even when model weights are frozen.
dVv1MBkavP.method: Harness Continual Learning (HCL) structures the harness into a Task Interface, Experience Memory, Capability Map, and Adaptive Router, and separates update proposal from commitment. A Continual Optimizer proposes candidate harnesses from post-execution feedback, and a Continual Evaluator commits them only after verifying improvement, historical retention, and validity.
dVv1MBkavP.key_idea: Separates candidate harness generation by an optimizer from state commitment gated by an evaluator checking improvement, retention, and validity.
dVv1MBkavP.evidence: Experiments on open-world capability accumulation, textual reasoning, and multimodal perception.
dVv1MBkavP.claimed_gains: Relative gains exceed 10% across evaluated capability accumulation, textual reasoning, and multimodal perception tasks.

F1PdFGnBPa.one_liner: Deterministic policy automata track obligations and select minimally disruptive interventions throughout web-agent trajectories.
F1PdFGnBPa.problem: Trajectory-level safety verdicts neither maintain policy obligations across decisions nor give agents actionable recovery guidance for task continuation.
F1PdFGnBPa.method: Praxis compiles natural-language policies into executable rule automata and maintains policy state throughout each trajectory. It confines the LLM to semantic interpretation and evidence grounding while deterministic logic controls lifecycle transitions and intervention selection.
F1PdFGnBPa.key_idea: Compile policies into stateful automata that deterministically choose the least disruptive admissible intervention at each decision point.
F1PdFGnBPa.evidence: The supplied abstract presents the compliance-control formulation and system design but truncates before reporting empirical evaluation.

Se9yH4X1Bo.one_liner: Witness-preserving local summaries support two-round distributed k-center clustering with outliers and group-fairness constraints.
Se9yH4X1Bo.problem: Distributed representative selection must jointly provide geometric coverage, outlier tolerance, and bounded group representation.
Se9yH4X1Bo.method: The two-round MapReduce framework stores unweighted summaries with z+1 nearby witnesses for every omitted point. Greedy merging handles outliers, while same-group candidates, LP-guided filtering, and maximum-weight bipartite b-matching handle fairness.
Se9yH4X1Bo.key_idea: Preserve nearby witnesses for omitted points so summary coverage extends to the original data without increasing the outlier budget.
Se9yH4X1Bo.evidence: Approximation and communication guarantees are complemented by experiments on six real-world datasets and one synthetic dataset with known optimal solutions.
Se9yH4X1Bo.claimed_gains: The framework achieves (6+ε)- and (11+ε)-approximations using O(kz) and O(k(z+g)) point records per worker, respectively.

5TGhv9bme1.one_liner: Evolves clinical LLM agent harnesses using a shared patient entity graph and a Candidate-DAG self-evolving proposer.
