5TGhv9bme1.problem: Clinical LLM agents struggle to keep patient state coherent over long workflows, while parameter-free harness optimization collapses under loosely structured evidence and fixed proposers.
5TGhv9bme1.method: The framework pairs a shared patient entity graph—tracking evolving clinical evidence, diagnostic hypotheses, and dependencies to coordinate memory, skills, and tools—with a self-evolving proposer. The proposer uses Candidate-DAG memory of alternative harnesses and an evolving skill library to avoid optimization collapse.
5TGhv9bme1.key_idea: Couples entity-graph-guided clinical state orchestration with a self-evolving proposer backed by Candidate-DAG memory and a reusable skill library.
5TGhv9bme1.evidence: Evaluated on long-horizon clinical decision-making workflows.

wjEHt2zt8J.one_liner: Connects heterogeneous weather observations, conflict-resolution reasoning, and reusable experience distillation in an operational weather agent.
wjEHt2zt8J.problem: Integrating AI weather forecasting tools into operational end-to-end workflows is hindered by heterogeneous observation semantics, conflicting evidence, and context-dependent forecasting strategies.
wjEHt2zt8J.method: MeteoSage integrates three components: unified heterogeneous data access with controlled tool execution, observation-grounded conflict assessment and resolution, and distillation of task feedback into reusable guidance. The authors also introduce WxFlowBench, a five-track benchmark spanning analysis, 0-3h nowcasting, 3h-15d forecasting, report generation, and emergency services.
wjEHt2zt8J.key_idea: Unifies tool execution, observation-linked discrepancy resolution, and feedback-distilled operational guidance in a multi-track weather agent.
wjEHt2zt8J.evidence: Evaluated on the five tracks (T0-T4) of WxFlowBench built from multi-source observations, operational forecast products, and real-world meteorological reports.

i6YzWkDiHK.one_liner: Optimizes time-interval bin edges by maximum likelihood for piecewise-constant neural temporal point process outputs.
i6YzWkDiHK.problem: Real-world inter-event time distributions often mix smooth and sharply peaked components that standard parametric neural point-process output densities represent poorly.
i6YzWkDiHK.method: The authors partition the time axis into fixed intervals and train a neural network to output a categorical distribution mapped to a piecewise-constant probability density. They introduce an optimization procedure that selects interval edges to maximize data likelihood under this representation.
i6YzWkDiHK.key_idea: Selects non-uniform time-interval edges via likelihood maximization so a categorical neural output forms an expressive piecewise-constant inter-event density.
i6YzWkDiHK.evidence: Evaluated on next-event prediction on real-world event datasets.

GQpzASXYUm.one_liner: Learns lightweight shared query transformations to recalibrate attention over independently compiled, reused KV caches.
GQpzASXYUm.problem: Assembling independently prefilled KV caches breaks cross-document context, while cache-side token recomputation increases time to first token and leaves native queries mismatched.
GQpzASXYUm.method: QueryLens learns a lightweight shared transformation on queries—supporting token-level and statically folded attention-head-level calibration—to improve how reused KV states are read. It composes with existing cache-reuse and selective-recomputation methods with negligible measured TTFT overhead for the folded variant.
GQpzASXYUm.key_idea: Adapts queries via a lightweight shared (or statically folded head-level) transformation rather than relying solely on cache-side token recomputation.
GQpzASXYUm.evidence: Evaluated on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct across a three-task benchmark combined with A3 at 10% recomputation.
GQpzASXYUm.claimed_gains: Adding QueryLens to A3 at 10% recomputation raises three-task macro-F1 on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct from 26.5 to 69.1.

LIaAStZudm.one_liner: Extrapolates token-level logit differences between independent and failure-conditioned sequential rollouts for training-free test-time search.
LIaAStZudm.problem: Independent test-time sampling preserves diversity but ignores prior mistakes, whereas sequential revision leverages failed attempts but loses diversity and gets trapped by flawed reasoning.
LIaAStZudm.method: Failure Logit Extrapolation (FLEx) is a training-free contrastive decoding method that extrapolates the difference between token-level logits produced by independent sampling and sequential sampling conditioned on prior failed attempts.
LIaAStZudm.key_idea: Contrastively extrapolates token logits between clean independent generation and failure-conditioned sequential generation at decoding time.
LIaAStZudm.evidence: Evaluated across six math, coding, and instruction-following benchmarks and eight LLMs from 4B to 235B parameters.
LIaAStZudm.claimed_gains: Improves pass@8 by 3.3% over independent sampling and 11.5% over sequential sampling across six benchmarks and eight models.

LiswpsUNu2.one_liner: Distills datasets directly into shallow staircase quantum circuits via classical distribution matching with exact gradients.
LiswpsUNu2.problem: Quantum machine learning incurs high state-preparation costs across shots and samples, and distilling classical data before separate quantum encoding causes compilation loss or deep circuits.
LiswpsUNu2.method: Quantum Dataset Distillation (QDD) parameterizes each synthetic sample directly as a shallow staircase circuit corresponding to a low-rank tensor network. Circuit parameters are optimized classically with exact gradients via distribution matching under an explicit loading-depth budget without post-hoc synthesis.
LiswpsUNu2.key_idea: Unifies each distilled sample and its loading circuit as a low-rank staircase tensor-network circuit optimized classically by distribution matching.
LiswpsUNu2.evidence: Evaluated on MNIST and Fashion-MNIST under matched sample and loading budgets, including finite-shot training regimes.
LiswpsUNu2.claimed_gains: Uses 10 circuits per class (0.0017x full dataset size) for accuracy comparable to full-data training, reaching 95% of full-data accuracy in finite-shot training with >100x fewer shots/preparations.

EPBKKSJTu6.one_liner: Trains vision-based robot reward critics with privileged state supervision in 3D Gaussian Splatting digital twins for real-world transfer.
EPBKKSJTu6.problem: Post-training generalist real-world robot policies relies on sparse human-labeled outcomes because underlying task states are hidden behind visual observations.
EPBKKSJTu6.method: Sim2Critic trains lightweight vision-based reward critics in a 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) digital twin using privileged simulator states under either sparse success or dense progress supervision, then transfers them directly to real-world rollouts to supply offline and online RL rewards without per-episode annotation.
EPBKKSJTu6.key_idea: Supervises visual reward critics with privileged sparse or dense state labels inside a 3DGS digital twin and transfers them to real robot rollouts for RL.
EPBKKSJTu6.evidence: Evaluated across eight real-world manipulation tasks on two robot platforms with as few as ten real demonstrations per task, comparing against generalist reward models in evaluation and offline/online RL.

GSWsPpbud9.one_liner: Learns a soft node-to-prototype hypergraph incidence with decoupled shallow learned diffusion and independently controlled observed-structure filtering.
GSWsPpbud9.problem: Hypergraph structure learning couples learned and observed structures under one propagation schedule, preventing independent control of diffusion depth and causing excessive global mixing.
GSWsPpbud9.method: PANDA learns an O(NK) soft incidence between N nodes and K trainable feature-space prototypes, applies shallow diffusion over the prototype-induced operator, runs an independently tuned observed-view filter (one-step smoothing or deeper restart propagation), and fuses both views via a learned scalar gate per layer without materializing dense node-to-node matrices.
GSWsPpbud9.key_idea: Decouples shallow diffusion over an O(NK) soft node-to-prototype incidence from an independently deep observed-hypergraph filter, combining both with a per-layer scalar gate.
GSWsPpbud9.evidence: Evaluated across 12 node classification benchmarks against hypergraph neural network baselines including TF-HNN.
GSWsPpbud9.claimed_gains: Across 12 node classification benchmarks, PANDA achieves an average accuracy rank of 2.00 compared with 4.58 for the runner-up TF-HNN.

ry1GwNaAFc.one_liner: Adapts a pretrained MM-DiT for multimodal reasoning via block-wise discrete flow matching and positive-gated cross-modal GRPO.
ry1GwNaAFc.problem: Unified MM-DiT models rely on full-sequence text denoising that hinders coherent long-range reasoning and suffer from weak cross-modal visual-to-text feedback.
ry1GwNaAFc.method: UniFlux adapts a pretrained MM-DiT for multimodal understanding using block-wise discrete flow matching while preserving its generation prior. It further trains with X-GRPO, which multiplies separately normalized text and image advantages through positive-gated credit so positive reward requires exceeding group baselines on both reasoning quality and image-regeneration fidelity.
ry1GwNaAFc.key_idea: Adapts a pretrained MM-DiT with block-wise discrete flow matching and trains it via X-GRPO multiplicative positive-gated credit over both text reasoning and image regeneration.
ry1GwNaAFc.evidence: Evaluated across eleven multimodal understanding and generation benchmarks.

Eeo6u7hiYd.one_liner: Evaluates video-model physics by scoring each scenario across a set of LLM-rewritten equivalent prompts.
Eeo6u7hiYd.problem: Single-prompt physics benchmarks for video generation models are highly sensitive to semantically and physically equivalent prompt rewording.
Eeo6u7hiYd.method: The authors propose Prompt Set Evaluation, which uses an LLM to generate validated, semantically and physically equivalent prompt sets per scenario and aggregates scores as a mean with variation. Using five prompts per scenario stabilizes both physical scores and model rankings.
Eeo6u7hiYd.key_idea: Replace each single benchmark prompt with a validated set of semantically and physically equivalent prompts and report mean score and variation.
Eeo6u7hiYd.evidence: Evaluates five video generation models on VideoPhy-2 and PhyGenBench with fixed seeds, repeatable evaluators, and a blinded human study.
Eeo6u7hiYd.claimed_gains: Prompt rewriting alone changes physical scores in 35.5% and 35.7% of cases, flips official pass decisions in 13.3%, and alters point rankings of 4 of 5 models on each benchmark.

3YjhkOMRIF.one_liner: Controls asynchronous RL policy lag by ranking completed trajectories with pool-aware waiting and prefix-aware generation staleness.
3YjhkOMRIF.problem: Fully asynchronous RL for LLM post-training suffers from policy staleness as trajectories are generated and queued while the policy continues updating.
3YjhkOMRIF.method: The authors decompose trajectory lag into Generation Staleness and Waiting Staleness and introduce PACE (Pool-Aware Control of Effective Staleness). PACE converts excess pool occupancy into an adaptive rejection budget and ranks trajectories by combining Waiting Staleness with prefix-aware Generation Staleness.
3YjhkOMRIF.key_idea: Convert excess trajectory-pool occupancy into an adaptive rejection budget and rank trajectories by combined waiting and prefix-aware generation staleness.
3YjhkOMRIF.evidence: Evaluates PACE against unfiltered asynchronous RL and synchronous RL on six single-turn mathematical reasoning benchmarks and multi-turn tool-integrated reasoning.
3YjhkOMRIF.claimed_gains: Improves six-benchmark average validation accuracy in single-turn mathematical reasoning by 18.7% over unfiltered asynchronous RL at the same wall-clock budget and matches synchronous RL with 47.1% less GPU time.

ddEHXdTXQA.one_liner: Trains Mixture-of-Experts Looped Transformers (20B-A2B and 6B-A0.6B) with a post-training method for reasoning.
ddEHXdTXQA.problem: Given an N-times increase in pre-training compute, scaling parameter count by N typically outperforms looping a Transformer N times.
ddEHXdTXQA.method: The authors present the Loopie series of two MoE Looped Transformers—20B total / 2B active parameters and 6B total / 0.6B active parameters—paired with a post-training method for reasoning.
ddEHXdTXQA.key_idea: Combine Mixture-of-Experts sparsity with looped Transformer execution and reasoning post-training under matched pre-training compute.
ddEHXdTXQA.evidence: Conducts ablation studies comparing Loopie against compute-matched vanilla Transformer baselines, including a vanilla 30B-A3B model.

BTXXE7Zm0F.one_liner: Uses prior coding-agent trajectories outside the agent context to choose states for targeted rollout branching.
BTXXE7Zm0F.problem: Independent trajectory sampling for coding-agent post-training becomes redundant, while feeding prior trajectories as in-context advice creates train-test mismatch.
BTXXE7Zm0F.method: The authors introduce SWE-Trail, a trajectory collector that inspects earlier trajectories outside the coding agent's context to identify states warranting additional collection effort. Upon reaching such a state during a new rollout, the agent proposes candidate next actions solely from its ordinary context.
BTXXE7Zm0F.key_idea: Use trajectory history outside the agent prompt to pick rollout states for extra sampling while letting the agent generate actions unaided.

XpMAJ4jR69.one_liner: Fine-tunes image-to-video models jointly on abstract physics simulations with detailed captions and real videos.
XpMAJ4jR69.problem: Pretrained photorealistic image-to-video models lack physical fidelity without relying on expensive photorealistic simulation rendering or inference-time simulators.
XpMAJ4jR69.method: Sim-∞ fine-tunes a pretrained image-to-video model on visually abstract, minimally textured physics simulations paired with detailed captions while co-training on randomly sampled real videos to preserve photorealism. Ablations study the simulation-to-real-video ratio and caption design.
XpMAJ4jR69.key_idea: Jointly fine-tunes on captioned abstract physics simulations for physical dynamics and randomly sampled real videos to retain photorealism without an inference-time simulator.
XpMAJ4jR69.evidence: Experiments evaluate object permanence under occlusion, rigid-body collision dynamics, and deformable-body wave propagation on an independently constructed photorealistic physics benchmark, Physics-IQ-Verified, and VBench++ against a real-video-only baseline.
XpMAJ4jR69.claimed_gains: Physics-IQ-Verified increases from 47.98 to 49.80 while VBench++ scores remain closely matched.

UwMYxYHQSG.one_liner: Performs history-free speculative decoding by reusing target-model hidden states with a lightweight sequential head.
UwMYxYHQSG.problem: In long-context multi-turn agentic workloads, speculative decoding draft models suffer up to 80% acceptance-length degradation and high historical KV-cache overhead.
UwMYxYHQSG.method: DLite reuses contextual hidden states directly from the target LLM for local speculative prediction without maintaining a draft historical KV cache, adds a lightweight sequential head to restore intra-block causal dependencies, and uses a two-stage training strategy.
UwMYxYHQSG.key_idea: Reuses target-model contextual hidden states for local drafting with a lightweight sequential head, eliminating the draft model's historical KV cache.
UwMYxYHQSG.evidence: Experiments evaluate DLite on general-purpose, long-context, and agentic workloads against DSpark.
UwMYxYHQSG.claimed_gains: DLite achieves 2~6 acceptance length and outperforms DSpark.

C0Kdy12R9J.one_liner: Converts pretrained autoregressive LLMs into blockwise semi-continuous diffusion language models using analytically sampled intermediate states.
C0Kdy12R9J.problem: Converting pretrained autoregressive LLMs into continuous-state diffusion language models that retain partially resolved token information typically requires large amounts of additional data and training.
C0Kdy12R9J.method: SC-dLLM applies a brief continuous endpoint initialization for same-position prediction and then adapts the backbone on analytically sampled corrupted intermediate states using the vocabulary prediction objective. During generation, blocks evolve from masks through continuous states with token predictions guiding stochastic updates and confident-position commitment.
C0Kdy12R9J.key_idea: Adapts an autoregressive LLM to blockwise continuous-state denoising via continuous endpoint initialization, analytically sampled intermediate states, and confidence-based token commitment.
C0Kdy12R9J.evidence: Evaluations at 1.5B and 7B scales (using ~1.1B additional tokens at 7B) cover code generation (HumanEval and MBPP Base/Plus), mathematics, instruction following, and knowledge-intensive QA against AR-initializer, AR fine-tuning, Fast-dLLM v2, and Fast-dLLM v2-FT.
C0Kdy12R9J.claimed_gains: SC-dLLM reaches average scores of 46.8 at 1.5B and 63.89 at 7B with approximately 1.1B additional training tokens at 7B, exceeding AR-initializer, AR fine-tuning, Fast-dLLM v2, and Fast-dLLM v2-FT at both scales.

wxzkWJESGA.one_liner: Jointly generates spherical field-of-view camera parameters and perspective images from 360-degree panoramas using a DiT backbone.
wxzkWJESGA.problem: Converting 360-degree omnidirectional panoramas into well-composed perspective photographs requires jointly deciding where to look and rendering the corresponding view.
wxzkWJESGA.method: PanoWeaver uses a DiT backbone with bidirectional interaction to jointly generate spherical field-of-view (SFoV) virtual camera states and their corresponding perspective images from a 360-degree panorama, optionally conditioned on text. The authors also construct PanoComp-100K with 100,200 samples containing SFoV states, perspective views, and human composition annotations.
wxzkWJESGA.key_idea: Couples explicit SFoV virtual camera generation and perspective image synthesis through bidirectional interaction inside a DiT backbone.
wxzkWJESGA.evidence: Experiments evaluate PanoWeaver on panorama reframing using the PanoComp-100K dataset (100,200 samples) against existing alternatives.

gMrJBmCBtl.one_liner: Generates 2K image-to-video outputs via low-resolution motion synthesis followed by image-conditioned segment-wise generation.
gMrJBmCBtl.problem: At 2K resolution, end-to-end image-to-video models are prohibitively expensive in memory and latency, while cascading low-resolution I2V with generic video super-resolution drifts from input image details.
gMrJBmCBtl.method: SwiftI2V first generates a low-resolution motion reference and then performs strongly image-conditioned 2K synthesis guided by that motion. It introduces Conditional Segment-wise Generation (CSG) to synthesize videos segment-by-segment under a bounded per-step token budget with bidirectional contextual interaction within each segment.
gMrJBmCBtl.key_idea: Combines a low-resolution motion reference with strongly image-conditioned segment-wise 2K generation under a bounded token budget and intra-segment bidirectional context.

zQKlKPqUHw.one_liner: Evolves generative recommendation supervision via nested LLM-guided supervision diagnosis and feedback-driven policy updates.
zQKlKPqUHw.problem: Next-token prediction on observed interactions uses incomplete preference proxies, and static supervision enrichment ignores what the current model has already learned.
zQKlKPqUHw.method: The framework pairs two nested loops: an outer Supervision Evolution Cycle (SEC) where LLMs analyze updated performance feedback to diagnose supervision gaps and construct new targets, and an inner Feedback-Guided Learning Cycle (FGLC) that updates the policy for incorporating added supervision based on observed learning effects.
zQKlKPqUHw.key_idea: Combine an LLM-driven outer loop that diagnoses and constructs new targets with an inner loop that adapts supervision-weighting policies from learning feedback.
zQKlKPqUHw.evidence: Evaluated in multi-round offline industrial recommendation retrieval experiments and online A/B testing.

suXvvKvZfq.one_liner: Distills viewpoint-conditioned features from a frozen video world model into a VLM's visual pathway with a preservation anchor.
suXvvKvZfq.problem: Vision-language models excel at semantic recognition but remain brittle on basic single-image spatial relations like left of, behind, and between.
suXvvKvZfq.method: GeoWorld-VLM feeds static training images with sampled camera trajectories and a scene-stability prompt into a frozen camera-conditioned video world model to generate teacher features. It aligns post-projector VLM visual features to the teacher while a preservation anchor constrains drift into the frozen LLM, dropping teacher and alignment heads at inference.
suXvvKvZfq.key_idea: Align a VLM's post-projector visual features to camera-conditioned video world-model teacher features under an interface-preservation anchor while keeping the LLM frozen.
suXvvKvZfq.evidence: Evaluated across two VLM backbones on What'sUp+VSR and EmbSpatial against task-only fine-tuning and alternative feature teachers.
suXvvKvZfq.claimed_gains: Improves over matched task-only fine-tuning by 1.53–3.52 percentage points across two VLM backbones on What'sUp+VSR and EmbSpatial with no extra inference cost.

DGm7J4CL9A.one_liner: Corrects heterogeneous federated label noise via global generative latent-label inference, dynamic priors, and noise-aware aggregation.
DGm7J4CL9A.problem: Existing federated noisy-label methods rely on local label correction without global context and lack convergence theory under dual data-and-noise heterogeneity.
DGm7J4CL9A.method: FedCoIn treats ground-truth labels as latent variables inferred through global generative modeling across clients under privacy constraints. It stabilizes inference and harmonizes updates using a distribution-aware dynamic prior and a noise-aware weighted aggregation strategy, backed by convergence analysis across three heterogeneity regimes.
DGm7J4CL9A.key_idea: Infer latent ground-truth labels via cross-client generative modeling stabilized by distribution-aware dynamic priors and noise-aware weighted aggregation.
DGm7J4CL9A.evidence: Supported by theoretical convergence analysis under three regimes: noise-only heterogeneity, data-only heterogeneity, and dual data-noise heterogeneity.

iFUAMZKvxE.one_liner: Computes multi-group fair linear top-k scoring functions with a utility-loss disparity objective and tractable small-k algorithms.
iFUAMZKvxE.problem: Prior fair top-k linear scoring work only handled a single protected group without disparity minimization and overlooked an issue that can invalidate fairness.
iFUAMZKvxE.method: The authors generalize fair linear top-k selection to multiple protected groups while minimizing disparity from a reference scorer using a new utility-loss measure for stability under weight perturbations. After showing general intractability even in 2D, they exploit a structural gap to build an augmented two-pronged algorithm efficient for small k and few groups.
iFUAMZKvxE.key_idea: Minimize a perturbation-stable utility-loss disparity over multi-group fair linear top-k scorers using an algorithm exploiting small-k and few-group tractability.
iFUAMZKvxE.evidence: Supported by computational complexity analysis and empirical evaluation on real-world datasets (names not stated).

3dkS3uWze1.one_liner: Forecasts 4D surround-view occupancy in one pass by lifting object queries into anisotropic 3D Gaussians propagated by predicted displacements.
3dkS3uWze1.problem: Dense voxel and BEV occupancy forecasters scale poorly with resolution and horizon and fail to preserve object instance consistency over time.
3dkS3uWze1.method: LighTROcc represents movable objects with compact learned queries localized via attention-guided forward lifting using image cross-attention, query-specific depth, and camera geometry. Each instance is modeled as a mixture of anisotropic 3D Gaussians propagated across future timesteps by predicted displacements in a single forward pass.
3dkS3uWze1.key_idea: Lift learned object queries into mixtures of anisotropic 3D Gaussians and propagate them across future steps with predicted displacements in one pass.
3dkS3uWze1.evidence: Evaluated on nuScenes and supplemented nuScenes-Occupancy against dense and instance-wise baselines across multiple model configurations.

XkbDKwQYgJ.one_liner: Resolves conflicting multimodal emotion cues via modality-ablated SFT, cue-grounded consistency scoring, and conflict-conditioned policy optimization.
XkbDKwQYgJ.problem: Existing multimodal emotion reasoning methods fuse visual, acoustic, and text cues without explicitly modeling which modality to trust during cross-modal conflicts.
XkbDKwQYgJ.method: EmoTrust first performs multi-view SFT on full and modality-ablated inputs, then estimates cross-modal consistency via cue-grounded modality-level emotion support distributions. It applies conflict-conditioned policy optimization comparing full versus ablated confidence to estimate modality contributions and reinforce reasoning grounded in the more informative modality.
XkbDKwQYgJ.key_idea: Compare model confidence across full and modality-ablated inputs to quantify cross-modal conflict and reinforce reliance on the more informative modality via policy optimization.
XkbDKwQYgJ.evidence: Evaluated on an open-vocabulary emotion understanding benchmark and its human-annotated cross-modal conflict subset (dataset name not stated).

oSTZF0NgBO.one_liner: Improves feed-forward 3DGS under large viewpoint changes by freezing geometry, aligning training Gaussians with ground-truth poses, and wide-angle supervision.
oSTZF0NgBO.problem: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian reconstruction struggles to learn accurate Gaussian attributes from predicted geometry for high-quality rendering across large viewpoint shifts.
oSTZF0NgBO.method: InfiniSplat v2 decouples geometry and attribute prediction using a frozen geometry branch, aligns predicted Gaussians with ground-truth camera poses during training, and supervises on large-angle target views. The authors also analyze how image-only reconstruction loss causes learned opacity to suppress geometrically inconsistent points.
oSTZF0NgBO.key_idea: Decouple geometry via a frozen branch, align predicted Gaussians to ground-truth training poses, and train with large-angle target view supervision.
oSTZF0NgBO.evidence: Evaluated across six datasets (names not stated) in both pose-conditioned and pose-free feed-forward 3DGS settings.
oSTZF0NgBO.claimed_gains: In the pose-conditioned setting across six datasets, reduces mean LPIPS by 25.8% and DISTS by 32.9% compared with the strongest evaluated baselines.

seJjZPgtaO.one_liner: Aligns few-step causal video models online over distilled timesteps and policy-rolled streaming contexts with detached historical KV caches.
seJjZPgtaO.problem: Post-distillation policy optimization for few-step causal autoregressive video models suffers from timestep and rollout-context mismatches relative to deployed streaming inference.
seJjZPgtaO.method: The proposed dual-support online policy optimization framework performs relative forward-process updates exclusively on the discrete timestep set retained by the few-step sampler. It optimizes candidate continuations under the policy's own long-horizon autoregressive contexts while detaching historical KV states to keep updates local.
seJjZPgtaO.key_idea: Restrict relative forward-process policy updates to distilled sampler timesteps under self-generated streaming rollouts with detached historical KV states.
seJjZPgtaO.evidence: Evaluated across multiple distilled autoregressive video backbones and generation horizons (specific names not stated).

TPLd7AlBLv.one_liner: Forecasts human motion by predicting eye-body coordination states to guide base prediction, residual diffusion, and causal candidate verification.
TPLd7AlBLv.problem: Human motion forecasting methods have not explicitly modeled structured eye-body coordination despite its link to actions, intentions, and task progression.
TPLd7AlBLv.method: CoordMotion learns structured eye-body coordination states from semantic text and physical values, then forecasts their evolution to guide both deterministic base motion prediction and horizon-dependent residual diffusion. At test time, a causal Coordination-Guided Verifier uses predicted coordination states to rank and select stochastic motion candidates.
TPLd7AlBLv.key_idea: Forecast structured eye-body coordination states to condition base prediction, residual diffusion, and causal test-time ranking of motion samples.
TPLd7AlBLv.evidence: Evaluated on deterministic and stochastic human motion forecasting using the EE4D-Motion and Nymeria datasets.

sw42PnJGWw.one_liner: Routes compact VLA action chunks from a coarse flow decoder to a selective low-noise refinement stage based on learned difficulty.
sw42PnJGWw.problem: Compact flow-based vision-language-action models spend identical decoding compute on every action chunk regardless of prediction difficulty.
sw42PnJGWw.method: DepthFlow-VLA uses a two-stage coarse-to-refine flow-matching decoder where Stage A generates a coarse action and a lightweight router selectively triggers a restart-style low-noise Stage B. Training combines difficulty-weighted velocity loss, routing supervision, and a Stage-B objective built on replayed Stage-A predictions.
sw42PnJGWw.key_idea: Pair a coarse flow-matching action decoder with a learned router that invokes restart-style low-noise refinement only on harder chunks.
sw42PnJGWw.evidence: Evaluated on LIBERO and SimplerEnv-WidowX with a compact 0.5B model against uniform refinement, random routing, and vanilla flow-matching controls, plus H100 latency profiling.
sw42PnJGWw.claimed_gains: Reaches 98.3% on LIBERO (using 7.54 vs. 13.0 decoder evaluations per chunk, vs. 95.9% Stage-A-only, 98.5% uniform, and 94.8% vanilla control) and 80.2% on SimplerEnv-WidowX (vs. 81.3% uniform, 76.0% random routing, and 72.2% vanilla control), cutting H100 latency from 59.2 to 42.6 ms.

ENeoGllR2l.one_liner: Decomposes reasoning accuracy curves into within-chain commitment drift versus survivorship bias to diagnose harmful overthinking and stopping gains.
ENeoGllR2l.problem: Final-correctness probes estimate conserved verdicts that cannot detect whether continuing a reasoning chain will degrade an already correct answer, and aggregate curves conflate drift with survivorship bias.
ENeoGllR2l.method: The authors derive two identities: the gap between current-stop correctness (commitment) and final correctness (verdict) equals expected remaining accuracy change, while accuracy-versus-budget curves split into within-chain answer change and changes in which chains remain active. They measure matched continuations and oracle stopping gains across reasoning models.
ENeoGllR2l.key_idea: Separate within-chain commitment-verdict drift from survivorship bias over active chains using exact conservation and budget-curve decomposition identities.
ENeoGllR2l.evidence: Theoretical identities paired with measurements on six reasoning models from three families (including DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B) on MATH-500 and OlympiadBench up to 16,384 tokens.
ENeoGllR2l.claimed_gains: Continuing from 379 correct-answer points in DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B on MATH-500 loses 3.6 points on average (95% CI [2.2, 5.2]), while an oracle stopping rule gains at most +1.8 points at 1.5B and +2.5 points at 7B.

ODjxxjz0zH.one_liner: Pretrains time-series foundation models via federated diffusion reconstruction, sub-domain adversarial prototype alignment, and domain-aware server aggregation.
ODjxxjz0zH.problem: Coupled inter-domain and intra-domain time-series heterogeneity causes representation collapse and gradient conflict in centralized pretraining, while standard FL assumes homogeneous clients.
ODjxxjz0zH.method: FedTRL addresses intra-domain variability locally by combining diffusion-based reconstruction with sub-domain adversarial regularization and prototype alignment. On the server, domain-aware aggregation (DaG) reweights client updates by prototype discriminability and global semantic alignment to mitigate inter-domain interference.
ODjxxjz0zH.key_idea: Pair local diffusion reconstruction and sub-domain adversarial prototype alignment with server-side client reweighting based on prototype discriminability and semantic alignment.
ODjxxjz0zH.evidence: Evaluated on point and probabilistic forecasting against centralized and federated TSFM baselines under domain imbalance, concept drift, and unseen-domain transfer (dataset names not stated).

oXag16nk6j.one_liner: Repairs multimodal reasoning chains without training by detecting early-error inheritance via local masking tests and rolling back to regenerate.
oXag16nk6j.problem: Multimodal reasoning models exhibit answer inheritance, where early mistaken judgments continue supporting later steps and persist into the final answer.
oXag16nk6j.method: After diagnosing step-to-step interventional support via offline Shapley attribution, the authors propose BANKROLL, a training-free inference method with three stages. Cashout monitors intermediate answers to stop thinking, Refinance uses online local masking tests to pick a rollback point and sample alternative continuations, and Writeoff retains the original chain if acceptance checks fail.
oXag16nk6j.key_idea: Use online local step-masking tests to locate influential early reasoning steps, truncate before them, and accept regenerated continuations only if they pass a probe check.
oXag16nk6j.evidence: Evaluated across five benchmarks and three multimodal models (names not stated) against standard chain-of-thought.

pKRT8nTFj6.one_liner: Compresses AdamW optimizer states by inferring shared second-moment blocks from squared gradients and codebook-quantizing first moments.
pKRT8nTFj6.problem: AdamW's first- and second-moment buffers add roughly two parameter-sized copies to training memory, while prior block-sharing methods rely on manual architectural rules.
pKRT8nTFj6.method: Gefen proves that large mixed Hessian entries push squared-gradient ratios toward one, enabling automatic inference of second-moment sharing blocks directly from initial squared gradients without architecture metadata. It combines this block sharing with dynamic-programming codebook quantization of first moments.
pKRT8nTFj6.key_idea: Infer Hessian-aligned parameter blocks directly from initial squared gradients to share second moments and quantize first moments with a learned codebook.
pKRT8nTFj6.evidence: Supported by a theoretical proof linking mixed Hessian entries to squared-gradient ratios (empirical benchmarks not specified in the abstract).
pKRT8nTFj6.claimed_gains: Reduces AdamW optimizer-state memory by up to 8x (6.5 GiB per billion parameters) while maintaining the same performance.

2dM9IlEf6l.one_liner: Generates text-controlled time series by learning disentangled discrete codebooks of temporal primitives and composing them under semantic constraints.
2dM9IlEf6l.problem: Coupling semantic understanding and sequence modeling in one representation binds temporal patterns to observed joint distributions, hurting local-event accuracy and compositional control.
2dM9IlEf6l.method: VQ-PACT learns disentangled discrete temporal primitives for morphological skeletons, rhythms, and local events, stabilized via recombination-based training into a reusable temporal grammar. It aligns text descriptions with primitive shapes and composes them under semantic constraints to generate faithful time series.
2dM9IlEf6l.key_idea: Learn disentangled discrete codebooks for skeletons, rhythms, and local events via recombination training and compose them according to text-aligned semantics.

AEKjeojnLc.one_liner: Scales panoramic outdoor 3DGS via coarse sky-depth initialization and parallax-uncertainty, gradient-importance spatial partitioning.
AEKjeojnLc.problem: Full 360-degree visibility in equirectangular panoramic images breaks frustum-based partitioning for large outdoor 3DGS, degenerating block-wise training into global training.
AEKjeojnLc.method: PanoLOG uses a two-stage coarse-to-fine pipeline: a global coarse stage with sky-sphere modeling and panoramic monocular depth supervision, followed by a refinement stage using Geometry and Gradient-based Partitioning (G²PS). G²PS builds adaptive bounding volumes from parallax-driven uncertainty and assigns cameras via gradient-based importance scoring, evaluated on the new Pano360 benchmark.
AEKjeojnLc.key_idea: Partition panoramic 3DGS scenes using parallax-uncertainty bounding volumes and gradient-importance camera assignment after global sky-sphere and depth-supervised coarse initialization.
AEKjeojnLc.evidence: Evaluated on the newly constructed Pano360 large-scale panoramic outdoor scene reconstruction benchmark.

nAS3H9xtxB.one_liner: Retrieves Lean 4 premises by propagating semantic relevance over a Mathlib forward-dependency graph and reranking expanded candidates.
nAS3H9xtxB.problem: Existing formal premise retrievers match declarations directly to target statements, missing lexically dissimilar supporting lemmas reachable through multi-hop proof dependencies.
nAS3H9xtxB.method: LeanGraphSearch builds a directed graph of Mathlib declarations linked to the premises they depend on. Starting from semantically matched declarations, it runs a graph-based ranking algorithm to propagate relevance across multi-hop forward dependency chains and reranks the expanded candidates against the original query.
nAS3H9xtxB.key_idea: Propagate semantic match scores across a Mathlib forward-dependency graph to surface multi-hop supporting lemmas before reranking against the query.
nAS3H9xtxB.evidence: Evaluated on MathlibQR and MathlibMPR retrieval benchmarks against LeanSearch v2 and integrated into an iterative end-to-end theorem prover.
nAS3H9xtxB.claimed_gains: Improves recall by up to 12% over LeanSearch v2 on MathlibQR and increases complete annotated proof-route coverage on MathlibMPR by up to 3.7% of extra groups.

VJntBXymeN.one_liner: Proves fixed transformers fail to memorize arbitrary-length Turing machines while a formal decision-execution-memory agent architecture is Turing complete.
VJntBXymeN.problem: Prior Turing-completeness analyses of transformers assume input-length-dependent settings, leaving their unbounded-length computational power unclear.
VJntBXymeN.method: The authors theoretically analyze single fixed transformers under unbounded input lengths, proving that finite-precision models cannot memorize certain Turing machines such as arithmetic and that randomly trained infinite-precision transformers are not Turing complete with probability one under stated conditions. They then formalize an agent with decision, execution, and memory modules and prove it can simulate any Turing machine.
VJntBXymeN.key_idea: Contrast unbounded-length memorization limits of single fixed transformers against a constructive Turing-completeness proof for a decision-execution-memory agent architecture.
VJntBXymeN.evidence: Purely theoretical proofs covering finite-precision transformers, randomly trained infinite-precision transformers, and a formal agent model.

cYeHgON3f8.one_liner: Proves spectral deconfounding asymptotically restores the irrepresentable condition for Lasso causal variable selection under dense unobserved confounding.
cYeHgON3f8.problem: While spectral deconfounding improves Lasso estimation under dense unobserved confounding, whether it can reliably recover causally relevant variables (model selection) remained open.
cYeHgON3f8.method: The authors theoretically analyze spectral transformations of the design matrix that attenuate dominant singular directions induced by dense latent confounders. They prove this weakening of spurious covariate correlations allows the irrepresentable condition to hold asymptotically, enabling Lasso to select and optimize over the causal feature set and motivating l1-bias reduction.
cYeHgON3f8.key_idea: Show that attenuating dominant singular components of the design matrix asymptotically restores Lasso's irrepresentable condition for causal support recovery.
cYeHgON3f8.evidence: Supported by theoretical analysis of high-dimensional sparse linear regression under dense confounding.

3KrMH28tVS.one_liner: Reuses idle text positions in spoken language models' frame-rate grid to run compressed chain-of-thought reasoning in parallel with speech.
3KrMH28tVS.problem: Spoken language models decoding text and speech at mismatched frame rates leave idle text slots while full chain-of-thought traces would add speech latency.
3KrMH28tVS.method: Thinking in the Gaps repurposes idle text positions on the shared autoregressive grid for stepwise reasoning concurrent with speech generation. A context-conditioned compressor produces length-constrained reasoning targets sized to fit the available frame-rate gaps without inserting extra sequence positions.
3KrMH28tVS.key_idea: Insert context-compressed reasoning tokens into idle text slots created by text-speech frame-rate mismatch so reasoning runs in parallel with speech.
3KrMH28tVS.evidence: Evaluated across five spoken mathematical question-answering benchmarks (names not stated) at multiple frame rates against a matched parallel-generation baseline.
3KrMH28tVS.claimed_gains: Improves average accuracy over the matched parallel-generation baseline at every tested frame rate, with a maximum gain of 14.05 percentage points at 25 Hz and comparable latency.
